tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso

zhes bya ba bzhugs so / / rgya gar skad du/ ma hā sandhi tsitta bi sranta nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod ma'i mgon po yon tan gang chen mtsho/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin gting mtha' dpag yas shing*/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras yid bzhin 'byung ba'i gnas/ /phan bde'i sprin phung 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od gsal chos sku dri med rgyal ba'i khams/ /ma rig 'dzin pas srid pa 'dir 'khyams te/ /las dang nyon mongs mya ngam thang dkyil du?/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal gso bya/ /grogs dag dal 'byor rin chen snying po'i lus/ /'gro drug nang nas rnyed par shin tu dka'/ /ji ltar long bas rin chen gter rnyed bzhin/ /rab tu dga' bas phan bde bsgrub par bya/ /dal dang 'byor ba de yang gang zhe na/ / bdag ni sems dmyal yi dgas ma skyes shing*/ /dud 'gro tshe ring lha dang kla klo dang*/ /log lta sangs rgyas kyis stongs lkugs pa ste/ /mi khom brgyad po dag las rab 'das shing*/ /mi gyur yul dbus skyes dang dbang po tshang*/ /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad pa ste/ /rang 'byor dam pa lnga yang tshang gyur cing*/ /sangs rgyas byon dang chos gsungs bstan pa gnas/ /gnas phyir zhugs dang gzhan gyis snying brtse ba/ /gzhan 'byor lnga ste dal 'byor bco brgyad po/ /rang la legs par tshang ba'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /snying nas brtson pas thar pa bsgrub par bya/ /gal te tshe 'dir phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ / phyis nas bde 'gro'i sgra yang mi thos sh-ing*/ /ngan 'gror rgyun ring yang dang yang 'khor te/ /spang blang mi shes log pa'i lam 'gro zhing*/ /thog mtha' dus med 'khor bar 'khyams 'tshal lo/ /de bas da lta rang dbang yod dus 'dir/ / legs pa'i lam la mthun pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /dge chos mi zad tshogs gnyis bsten byas te/ /srid pa'i grong las rab tu 'da' bar mdzod/

/'khor ba'i chu gter pha mtha' yas 'di las/ /rin chen gru bo thob dus ma brgal na/ /gtan du nyon mongs sdug bsngal dba' klong du/ /rab tu 'khrugs tshe bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /de bas myur du brtson pa'i go bgos te/ /sems dang sems byung rnyog pa rab zhi'i phyir/ /ye shes dri med 'od gsal lam 'dzegs te/ /byang chub lam la bar chad med par mdzod/ /gang la bde legs chos kyi gzhir gyur pa/ /rin chen dri ma med pa'i snod rnyed nas/ /bdud rtsi'i chos char bsil ba mi 'dzin na/ /'khor ba'i gdung bas rang nyid brlag par zad/ / dpal ldan bde chen phan bde'i sprin tshogs can/ /ye shes chu bsil dam pa'i char chen yang*/ /dal 'byor sa gzhi 'gro sems gtsang mar 'bab/ /de phyir spro bas snying nas chos mdzod cig /ji ltar mtsho dbus g.yengs ba'i gnya' shing gi /bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud srid pas kyang*/ /mi nyid rnyed dka' lha ma'i ston pas gsungs/ /dal 'byor rin chen lus rnyed smos ci dgos/ /de bas de ring nyid nas brtson 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar mi yi lus rnyed tsam po dang*/ khyad par can dang mi lus rin po che/ /rim bzhin dge sdig mi shes chos min spyod/ /dbang po tshang yang mi lus phal pa ste/ /yul dbus skyes kyang mtha' 'khob kla klo nyid/ /bstan la ma zhugs pa dang dge sdig 'chol/ /tshe 'di gnyer zhing 'du 'dzis rnams par g.yengs*/ /mi bsrun 'phyar la phyi ma rgyang bsrings te/ /thar pa mi gnyer de dag chos thos na'ang*/ /mchog gi lus min rang bzhin bar ma ste/ /skabs 'gar dge la cung zad sems gzhol zhing*/ /phal cher sdig pas blo mig khebs pa'i phyir/ /rtags tsam bzung bas rang gzhan phan ci yod/ /de dag khyim pa'am dge sbyong gzugs gzung rung*/ /ngan 'gro rnams las cung zad 'phags pa'i phyir*/ /mi lus khyad par can zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /rab mchog skye bo dri med chos kyi snod/

/thos bsam snying po'i don la dbang 'byor zhing*/ rang nyid btul nas gzhan dag dge la 'god/ /sgrub ba'i ri rgyal rab tu mi g.yo ba/ /drang srong rgyal mtshan rnam pa de dag kun/ / khyim pa'am rab tu byung ba'i gzugs sla yis/ /mi lus rin chen lags par ston pas gsungs/ /de phyir dam pa rnams las chos thos te/ /chos bzhin bsgrub phyir chos la gnas pa dag /chos ldan rgyun bsring chos min 'gog byed cing*/ /chos don bsgrubs pas chos la gnas par mdzod/ /ring por mi thogs srid mtsho mthar brgal nas/ /zhi ba'i gling du myur 'gro mya ngan 'da'/ /gang zhig mir gyur dge goms mi byed na/ /de las blo gros blun pa gzhan med de/ / rin chen gling nas stong log byed pa bzhin/ /dal 'byor don med chud gson byed par zad/ /de bas rtag tu zhi ba'i chos mdzod cig /chos kyang sems la rag las de yang ni/ /dal 'byor la brten rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*/ /rgyu dang rkyen rnams du ma tshogs dus 'dir/ /chos kyi gtso bor rang gi sems thul cig /'chi bas 'jigs pa'i skye ba mtha' med du/ /phongs dang sdug bsngal char bzhin 'bab pa yang*/ /dal 'byor don med rnam par g.yeng las byung*/ /de phyir mngon mtho nges legs chos rnams kun/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsams las byung bas na/ /nyin mtshan mi dal brtson pas spro ba bskyed/ /'dir ni 'dren pa mthong ba don yod cing*/ /chos thos pa dang bsgrub pa'ang don yod la/ /tshe 'di don yod phyi ma 'bras bcas kun/ /dal 'byor lus rnyed las byung de yi phyir/ /rab tu dka' ba yang dang yang sgoms shig /lhar bcas 'jig rten dbus na 'gro ba'i gtso/ /nyan rang sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po yis/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i go 'phang brnyes pa yang*/ /mi lus rin chen mchog las byung bas na/ /lha bas lhag pa'i lus zhes dal 'byor bsngags/ /de phyir mi nyid thob la spro ba bskyed/

/rnam par mi rtog bden mthong ye shes sa/ /lha mi'i nang nas mir gyur rnyed sla ste/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab snying po yang*/ /mi yi lus rnyed 'bras bu 'grub par sla/ /de phyir theg pa che chung chos kyi rten/ / dal 'byor mi lus mchog tu 'phags par gsungs/ /ji ltar phongs pas nor mchog rnyed pa ltar/ /rmi lam nyid ces dogs dang 'jigs bzhin du/ / dga' zhing spro bas dal 'byor bsam par bya/ /'di phyir phan bde dam pa'i chos 'grub bo/ / de ltar dge legs snyan pa'i bdud rtsi 'dis/ /'gro kun don med g.yeng ba rab zhi nas/ /nags mthar song ste nyon mongs tshang tshing gis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// // de ltar rnyed dka'i dal ba thob gyur kyang*/ /skad cig mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te/ /rnam par brtags na snying po 'ga' med la/ /dbu ba rdos 'dra yid brtan mi rung bas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu nges par 'chi ba bsam/ /sdug bsngal yid mi bde ba kun gyi gzhi/ /nyon mongs 'byung khungs cher gyur lus 'di la/ /gos rgyan me tog phreng sogs bklubs gyur cing*/ /bza' btung bzang dgus mchod cing bsnyen bkur yang*/ /dus mthar mi rtag 'jig cing 'bral ba ste/ /wa dang bya rgod ce spyang zas 'di la/ /gces spras rtag 'dzin gtsang ba'i sems bor la/ /da lta nyid nas dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /sa gsum 'byor pa dam pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /tshangs dang bden 'byung mig stong dbang po sogs/ /grags dang bsod nams gzi 'od 'bar ba yang*/ /'chi bdag gnas las rgyal ba'i skabs med la/ /bsam gtan grub pas bskal par gnas pa yang*/ /las zad tshe na 'chi ba'i skabs mchis shing*/ /lha dang lha min grub pa rig sngags 'chang*/ /mi dbang 'gro ba phal pa ji snyed kyang*/ /'chi bas 'jigs pa'i skye ba pha mtha' yas/ /tshe 'di mi rtag rol ba'i char sprin

nang*/ /'chi bdag glog gi phreng ba gar byed cing*/ /nyin mtshan dus rnams 'gyur ba'i 'char 'bab pas/ /sa gsum myu gu ji snyed brlan par gyur/ /snod bcud mi rtag srid pa chags 'jig gi /me bdun chus gcig rlung gis 'thor ba'i tshe/ /khor yug rgya mtsho gling dang ris bskor ba'i/ /lhun po rin chen bzhi yang mi rtag cing*/ /thams cad nam mkha' gcig tu 'gyur ba'i skabs/ /nges par bsams te snying nas chos mdzod cig /'jig rten 'dren par rang rgyal slob ma'i tshogs/ /thub dbang sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po rnams/ /dngas pa'i mkha' la sngon med ri bong 'dzin/ /rgyu skar phreng ba rnams kyis bskor ba bzhin/ /lham me lhang nge lhan ner gsal ba yang*/ /mi rtag mya ngan 'da' tshul ston mdzad cing*/ /bstan pa rin chen nyi ma dpag med kyang*/ /sngon rabs sngon rabs nub par gyur la ltos/ /chu shing snying po med 'dra rang gi lus/ /sgyu ma'i khang pa 'dra ba c-is mi 'jig /de phyir nges par 'chi dang nam 'chi dang*/ /'dir 'chi 'dis 'chi nges pa 'ga' med de/ /tshe 'di snon med rtag tu god 'gyur zhing*/ /'chi ba'i rkyen mang 'tsho ba'i shas nyung bas/ /tshe la long med blo sno bstungs byas te/ /de ring nyid nas chos la brtson par rigs/ /'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i lding khang sems pa can/ /g.yo ba'i kun rtog skye bos brgyan pa yang*/ /rkyen las skyes phyir 'dus byas 'jigs pa'i chos/ /grong khyer rnying pa bzhin du mi rtag gis/ /myur ba nyid du dam pa'i chos mdzod cig*/ ji ltar rlung dmar nang zhugs mar me bzhin/ /skad cig mi rtag g.yo ba'i rang bzhin dang*/ /glo bur 'chi rkyen drag pos gtugs pa'i tshe/ /yun du mi gnas nges par 'chi bas na/ /da lta nyid du dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /'khor dang longs spyod nye bar 'brel ba'i gnyen/ /gzugs dang lang tsho dbang phyug rigs bzang yang*/ /thams cad bor te gcig pur 'gro dgos shing*/

/gang gis mi bstongs dkar nag rjes 'brang ba/ /de tshe chos las skyabs gzhan 'ga' med na/ /deng dus brtson pas ci phyir 'da' mi byed/ /'di ltar 'jig rten snga phyi'i rgyud soms dang*/ /snga rabs skye bo dpag med 'das gyur cing*/ /da lta'i sa steng 'gro ba phal cher yang*/ /lo brgya'i nang du nges par mi rtag la/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang tshul de'i rjes su 'gro/ /rgan rabs gzhon rabs skal mnyam 'das la ltos/ /bdag kyang rang bzhin de las ma 'das pas/ /nges par 'chi ba bsams nas chos mdzod cig /sa gsum dmyal ba srid rtse'i bar dag na/ / 'chi bdag gnas las thar pa 'ga' med de/ /kun kyang mi rtag 'gyur zhing snying po med/ /yid brtan mi rung shing rta'i 'phang lo 'dra/ khyad par mi yi 'jig rten 'tshe ba mang*/ /nad gdon gnod pa du ma'i gzhir gyur cing*/ /mtshon dang me dang g.yang sa gcan gzan dug /rgyal po dgra dang chom rkun la sogs kyis/ /'tsho ba'i srog 'joms phun tshogs 'jig par byed/ /'tshe ba med kyang skyes bu'i tshe 'gro ste/ /nyin mtshan skad cig thang cig 'gyur bas kyang*/ /'chi bdag gnas su nye bar gyur pa ni/ /'bab chu'i tshogs rnams rgya mtshor snyeg pa'am/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub rir ltung ba bzhin/ /zas bcas 'tsho ba'i rkyen rnams phun tshogs kyang*/ /dug bzhin sdug bsngal byed pa'i skabs mchis na/ /mi mthun gnod mang phun tshogs cis mi 'jig / des na 'chi ba'i rkyen du ma gyur med/ /gar 'chi cis 'chi nam 'chi cha med kyi/ /don med slu ba 'jig rten chos spongs la/ /snying nas mi rtag 'chi chos bsgrub par mdzod/ /'dir ni bdag gis dal 'byor gru rnyed cing*/ /bla ma'i man ngag gru 'dzin yod bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal chu bo brgal phyir mi brtson na/ /de las bslus pa 'di na gzhan med do/ /gang phyir ston pas rab bsngags rin chen snod/ /nyes kun mthar 'byin yang dag thob bzhin du/

/ rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor pa mi 'dzin na/ /'khor ba'i brtson rar rang nyid 'ching bar zad/ /kye ma ji ltar rdo la 'doms pa bzhin/ /'jig rten phal cher bsams shing skyo ba 'phel/ / bstan pas mi rtogs bshad pas go ba med/ /sang nyin 'chi yang rgyun ring rtag par 'dzin/ /'khor bas mi skyo nges 'byung rdul tsam med/ /shes bzhin nga rgyal go bzhin 'khrul pa byed/ / 'du 'dzis g.yengs la nyon mongs char 'bab pa'i/ /'gro la nam zhig bdag gis phan thogs 'gyur/ /'dir ni nyes pa'i chu gter brgal 'dod cing*/ /legs pa'i yon tan rmad byung bsgrub 'dod pas/ /da lta nyid du nges par 'chi ba bsam/ /nyin mtshan kun tu mi rtag 'ba' zhig bsgom/ /yang dang yang du nges 'byung skyo shas bskyed/ /des ni 'di phyir phan bde'i chos 'grub cing*/ /brtson 'grus drag pos sgrub la brtson pa dang*/ /tshe 'di blos thongs bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa 'jig /mdor na legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'grub/ /nyes kun mthar 'byin thar pa dam pa'i rgyu/ / chos kun rtsa ba mi rtag blo sna bstungs/ /de ltar chos tshul sprin kyi rnga sgra las/ / phan pa'i gdams ngag zab cing snyan bsgrags pas/ /'gro kun rnam g.yeng nyon mongs rtag 'dzin gyis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /tshe mi rtag pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // de ltar mi rtag khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos/ /rnam par 'gyur bas shin tu sdug bsngal te/ /sdug bsngal 'gyur dang 'du byed nyid gsum gyis/ /grong khyer drug gi 'gro kun nyam re thag /ji ltar me nang gcan gzan mi rgod khrod/ /rgyal po'i btson rar chud pa'i 'gro ba ltar/ /sdug bsngal snga phyi brgyud mas mnar bzhin du/ /da dung thar pa'i skabs med skyo ba 'phel/ /bde thob sdug bsngal bral 'dod blo yod kyang*/ /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras nyid la mngon par rgyug

/mar me'i 'od la phye ma leb bzhin du/ 'dod pa'i yul la chags sred 'dzin pas bslus/ de bzhin ri dgas bung ba nya dang glang*/ /sgra dang dri ro reg gis slu ba ltar/ /'dod pa'i yul lnga dag gis 'gro ba bslus/ /nam yang bde med sdug bsngal gyur la ltos/ /lha dang lha min dmyal ba yi dgas mi/ /byol song rigs drug zo chun rgyud mo bzhin/ /gcig nas gcig brgyud sdug bsngal pha mtha' yas/ /tshe rabs bgrangs tshe sems can re res kyang*/ /mdza' bshes dgra dang bar mi'i khur khyer nas/ /bde sdug phan gnod sbyin pa grangs mtha' yas/ /pha nyid mar gyur ma nyid sring mo nyid/ /de nyid bu 'gyur nges pa ma mchis shing*/ /mdza' bo dgrar gyur pa yang thug pa med/ /'di ltar 'jig rten snga phyi'i las bsams na/ /skyo ba bas kyang shin tu skyo ba 'phel/ /rang nyid grog sbur gyur pa'i lus rnams kun/ /gcig tu bsdoms te phung por byar yod na/ /lhun po rin chen bzhi bas ches mtho zhing*/ /ngus pa'i mchi ma rgya mtsho bzhi bas lhag /sems dmyal yi dgas gyur tshe 'thungs gyur ba'i/ /zangs zhun rnag khrag mi gtsang khu ba rnams/ /phyogs mtha' gtugs pa'i chu klung char mi phod/ /de bzhin gzhan rnams dpag yas nam mkha' 'dra/ /'dod phyir mgo dang yan lag bcad pa'i grangs/ /'jig rten rdul phran snyed kyis char mi phod/ /byol song grul bum gnod sbyin lto 'phye sogs/ /'gro ba'i khams gyur bde sdug grangs med myong*/ /tshangs dang brgya byin bsam gtan gzugs med dang*/ /sa gzhi rin chen bdun gyis legs skyong ba'i/ /mi dbang dpal sde phun tshogs de thob kyang*/ /ngan 'gror ltung bas ches cher sdug bsngal lo/ /tshe 'dir 'byor pa mtha' yas nyams dga' ba/ /mthon po'i rang bzhin can rnams tshe 'phos

nas/ /dbul bas nyam thag yang bran nyid gyur pa/ /rmi lam 'byor pa gnyid sad med pa bzhin/ /bde sdug mi rtag 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /shin tu bsams na ches cher skyo ba 'phel/ /de bas grong khyer gsum gyi sems can rnams/ /'khor ba'i bde la chags med byang chub bsgrub/ /lus ngag yid gsum 'dod gzugs gzugs med de/ /snang dang phyed snang mi snang grong khyer na/ /sdug bsngal 'gyur dang 'du byed gsum gyis gdungs/ /sems dang yid dang rnam shes mched pa yis/ /yul rnams bde sdug 'khrul 'khor rgyun mi 'chad/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes yid dang sgo lnga'i shes/ /rim bzhin mched pa mched pa'i rim pa yin/ /de las srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras 'byung*/ /rtsa ba ma rig gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa can/ /yul dang don dang sems su bag chags pas/ /nga dang nga yir 'dzin pas 'khor ba grub/ / sems nyid 'gyur med yongs grub chos sku yang*/ /ma rig 'dzin pas kun brtags goms pa yis/ /ma dag gzhan dbang ltar snang 'khrul pa can/ / yul don bdag gzhan gnyis snang gnyis su gzung*/ /de las sdug bsngal dpag med lhun gyis grub/ /nam zhig 'gyur med sems nyid don rtogs nas/ /phyin ci ma log yongs grub lam bsgoms pas/ /dag pa gzhan dbang zhing du legs son te/ /srid pa'i grong las ngal gso byed pa 'gyur/ /e ma brtag dkar 'khor ba'i pha mtha' yas/ /srid lam dub pa dag gi sdug bsngal ni/ /gang du skyes kyang bde ba 'ga' med de/ /mi dge bskyed pa'i 'bras bu mi bzad pa/ /rang snang log pas rmi lam nang bzhin du/ /'gro drug so sor myong ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /med snang 'khrul pas sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /re zhig mdor bsdus lung bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /yang sos lcags kyi mdag me 'bar ba'i steng*/ /phan tshun 'dus nas mtshon gyis srog dang 'bral/ /yang sos sgra yis sngar bzhin sdug bsngal ba/

/las zad bar du de ltar myong 'tshal lo/ /tshe tshad mi yi lo grangs lnga bcu la/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha yi nyin zhag gcig /de nyid sum cu zla ba bcu gnyis lo/ /lnga brgyas yang sos zhag gcig gong 'phel bas/ /rang lo lnga brgyar sdug bsngal brnag dgos so/ /de nyid rab tu dbye ba'i grangs bshad pa/ /mi lo bye ba phrag 'bum drug khri dang*/ /stong phrag gnyis su nges par mdo las gsungs/ /thig nag 'bar ba'i sog les gshags bzhin 'byar/ /'byar bzhin gshogs pas shinatu sdug bsngal ba/ /mi yi lo brgya rtsa gsum zhag gcig ste/ /de yi lo stong thig nag zhag gcig la/ /rang lo stong thub mi lo bye ba phrag /sa ya nyis 'bum dgu khri drug stong rtsa/ /bcu gnyis bar du thub par ston pas gsungs/ /bsdus 'joms brag ri rta dang rnga mo dang*/ / stag dang seng ge la sogs 'dra ba'i bar/ /rdul phran bzhin 'joms gyes pas sngar bzhin 'tsho/ /lcags kyi ljongs su tho bas rdul bzhin 'thag /rab tu btsir bas khrag gi rgyun 'bab pa/ /mi lo nyis brgya 'thab bral zhag gcig ste/ /mtshe ma'i nyis stong bsdus 'joms nyin zhag gcig /rang lo stong phrag gnyis su sdug bsngal lo/ /de yang mi lo bye ba phrag sum 'bum/ /drug khri brgyad stong rtsa gcig thub par gsungs/ /ngu 'bod 'bar ba'i mes 'tshig 'o dod 'bod/ /lcags zhun bskor bar 'tshed pas sdug bsngal ba/ /mi lo bzhi brgya dga' ldan nyin zhag gcig /de yi bzhi stong ngu 'bod zhag gcig ste/ /rang lo bzhi stong bar du sdug bsngal ba/ /mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya gnyis dang*/ /bye ba phrag dgu 'bum bzhi khri stong dang*/ /bye ba bdun phrag bar du thub pa'i/ /'bod sgrogs chen po lcags khyim 'bar ba ru/ /'bar ba'i mes bsregs gshin rjes 'tshog par bgyid/ /mi lo brgyad brgya 'phrul dga'i zhag gcig ste/ /de lo brgyad stong ngu 'bod che'i zhag gcig /rang lo brgyad stong nyid du sdug bsngal

ba/ /mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya gsum dang*/ /bye ba phrag lnga 'bum lnga khri nyis stong*/ /drug cu rtsa drug bar du thub pa yin/ /tsha ba lcags khang nang zhugs mdung thung gis/ /klad pa 'gems shing tho bas rab tu brdung*/ /'bar ba'i me lces phyi nang kun du bsreg /mi'i lo stong dang drug brgya gzhan 'phrul zhag /de yi lo khri drug stong tsha ba'i zhag /rang lo khri dang drug stong bar thub pa/ /mi lo bye ba phrag sa ya brgyad dang*/ /bzhi 'bum dang ni bye ba khrag khrig phrag /drug stong lnga brgya sum cu snyed mchis so/ /rab tu tsha ba lcags khyim nyis rim nang*/ /'bar ba'i me dang mdung rtse gsum pas bsnun/ /spyi bo phrag pa gnyis byung leb mas dkris/ /zangs chen khol mar 'tshed pas sdug bsngal ba/ /tshe tshad bar gyi bskal pa phyed thub ste/ /mi lo'i grangs kyis gzhal ba'i yul las 'das/ / 'jig rten chags gnas 'jig stongs bskal chung bzhi/ /bar bskal gcig ste brgyad cu bskal chen no/ /mnar med lcags khang me lce 'bar ba'i nang*/ / sems dmyal ku co smre sngags 'don pa las/ /me dang sems can so sor mthong ba med/ /mar me 'bar ba snying po la zhen bzhin/ /srog gi zungs tsam me nang dbus gnas pa/ /bar bskal gnas pa'i yun gcig brnag dgos te/ /de las che ba'i sdug bsngal gzhan med pas/ /mnar med bstir med ces su bshad pa yin/ /gong du smos pa'i dmyal ba de dag kyang*/ /rim bzhin me lce bdun 'gyur gyis tsha la/ /'og mar snga ma'i sdug bsngal lhag dang bcas/ /ji srid las ma zad par sdug bsngal myong*/ /nyi tshe ri dang ljon shing nam mkha' dang*/ /brag bar me chu nges med gnas rnams su/ /nyung ngur gnas dang 'dus dang gcig pur gnas/ /der ni sdug bsngal gang rung re res gdungs/ /de phyir nyi tshe ba zhes bshad pa yin/ /gzhan dag tshe dang kha cig 'dus pa nyung*/ / de yis nyi tsher 'dod pa 'khrul pa ste/ /brag bar sdig gzugs tshe yang ring yod la/

/nyi tsher gdugs tshod 'dus pa'i nyan thos gzugs/ /lda brgya phan tshun mtshon gyis 'debs par gsungs/ /nye 'khor mnar med khang ba'i phyi rol bzhir/ /me mar mur dang ro myags mtshon cha'i thang*/ /chu bo rab med bzhi bzhi bcu drug go /mnar med sgo bye snyam las phyir 'thon pas/ /'obs bzang grib ma mthong nas phyin ma thag /mdag me 'bar ba pus mo nub brgal bas/ /sha kun tshig nas rus pa kunda'i mdog / yangs sos sngar bzhin shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /yang ni bsil ba'i 'dam mthong zhugs mthag /ro myags rul dri nga ba'i 'dam bying nas/ /lcags zangs gser gyi mchu can srin bus 'bigs/ slar yang thang nyams dga' mthong phyin ma thag /spu gri 'bar bas dum bur gtubs shing 'tsho/ /nags 'dab yid 'ong gang du phyin pa las/ /ral gri'i nag tshal las rlung 'khrug pas bcom/ /de 'das ri bo rab tu nyams dga'i rtser/ /sngon gyi yul 'bod mthong ste phyin pa las/ /lcags kyi thur ma rnon pos sha khrag gzags/ /steng du son tshe bya rgod klad pa 'gems/ /slar yang ri yi drung nas 'bod pa snyam/ /'thur du babs pas thur mas gyen du gzags/ / thang mtshams skyes pa bud med mche rnon can/ /'bar bas 'khyud de sh-in tu sdug bsngal zhing*/ khyi dang ce spyang mang pos za bar bgyid/ /yang ni bsil ba'i chu klung bab mthong nas/ /dga' bas song ste rab tu 'bog ma thag /thal tshan rked nub sha rus tshig gyur cing*/ 'gram gnyis gshin rje'i skyes bus bsrung bar mthong*/ /der ni lo stong mang por sdug bsngal lo/ /de lta'i dmyal bar su zhig 'jigs mi byed/ /srid na de 'dra'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /rang bzhin shes nas 'da' ba'i thabs 'tshal lo/ /grang bas nyam thag pa yang rnam pa brgyad/ /gangs sogs shin tu grang ba'i gnas dag tu/ /mun nag bu yug 'tshubs pas sbrebs pa'i lus/ /chu bur can dang chu bur rdol ba can/ / grang bas so 'thams smre sngags a chu zer/

/kyi hud utpal ltar gas padma dang*/ / padma che ltar gas pa'i rma nang du/ /srog chags mchu rnon 'bar bas za ba ni/ /ji srid las mtha' gtugs tshe g.yo bar 'gyur/ /tshe yi tshad ni ko sa la yi khal/ / bcu tshad nyi shu shong ba'i til rdzong nas/ /lo brgyar til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can tshe lhag ma nyi shur 'gyur/ /sems ldan dag gis sems dmyal 'jig rten las/ /rab tu rgyal phyir brtson pa'i stobs skyed cig /yi dgas dbyings mkhar rgyu ba'i dbyings gnas pa/ /lus tshe rkang lag phra zhing lto ba yangs/ mgrin pa phra zhing khab kyi mig tsam kha/ / zas skom mi rnyed bkres skom 'bar bas gdungs/ /sman shing me tog la sogs mthong bas bskams/ / phyi rol yid du mi 'ong ngan skyugs za/ /zas skom mthong yang bsrung bar snang ba dang*/ /nang gi sgrib pas lto bar me 'bar zhing*/ kha nas me lce dud par bcas pa 'thul/ /spyi mthun sgrib pas dbul phongs 'jigs sngangs 'tshe/ /nyam nga'i gnas su mgon med sdug bsngal nyen/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dgas 'dre rnams dang*/ /gnod sbyin srin po btsan dang rgyal po sogs/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul thogs med kun tu rgyu/ /gnod pa sna tshogs mngon par bsgrub pa ste/ /nad gtong mdang 'phrog tshe la bar du gcod/ /tshe tshad mi yi zla bar nyin zhag gcig /rang lo lnga brgya mi lo khri lnga stong*/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten dag tu sdug bsngal lo/ /de lta'i rang bzhin skyo ba'i tshul mthong nas/ /don mthun skye bos thar pa bsgrub pa'i phyir*/ /srid par dga' ba'i blo gros rgyang bsrings te/ /nges par zhi ba dam pa'i chos bsgrub bo/ /dud 'gro byings gnas chu gter bzhi yi khyon/ /gcig gis gcig za sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /gling bar mun nag rgya mtshor gnas pa yang*/ /tsha grang bkres skom gcig za'i 'tshe bas 'jigs/ kha 'thor mi yul bya dang ri dgas sogs/ /rngon pas gtse zhing rang rang gnod pas nyen/

/rta glang rnga mo ra dang bong bu sogs/ /bkol spyad rdeg 'tshog sdug bsngal mtha' yas shing*/ /sha dang pags pa rus pa'i phyir 'chi bas/ /rang bzhin sdug bsngal pha mtha' mi mngon zhing*/ /klu rnams nyin mtshan phyed ma'i bde sdug dang*/ snga dro phyi dro 'gyur ba'i bde sdug dang*/ kha cig gnas su bye tshan char 'bab la/ / la la gcig pur grogs bral phongs pas nyen/ /phal cher rmongs dang mkha' lding 'jigs la sogs/ /sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs du ma ldan/ /tshe yang ma nges kha cig nyin re la/ /'jog po la sogs bskal par gnas pa'ang gsungs/ /'di dag bsams nas byol song 'jig rten las/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis phan bde bsgrub pa'i phyir*/ /mngon mtho nges legs lam bzang srol btod la/ /nyin mtshan brtson pas dge la gzhol bar mdzod/ /mi rnams la yang bde ba'i skabasas med de/ /mya ngan yid mi bde dang 'khrug la sogs/ / gcig ma sangs par gcig gis sdug bsngal dang*/ /zas sogs dug 'dres zos pas 'gyur ba dang*/ /zas gos spyod lam nyes pas nad sogs su/ /phyi ma'i sdug bsngal 'du byed mtshon pa ste/ /sdug bsngal nyid gsum dag dang de bzhin du/ /skye rga na 'chi mi sdug phrad pa dang*/ /sdug bral 'dod pas phongs dang nye bar len/ /rnam pa brgyad kyi sdug bsngal tshad med de/ /ma rig rnam shes rlung sems thig ler 'dus/ /mer nur ltar mkhrang gor nya rus sbal 'dra/ / rim bzhin bdun phrag bdun du chags pa'i lus/ /ma yi ngal dub bkres skom tsha grang sogs/ /cung zad tsam la'ang sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /mun nag dog cing nyam nga dri mi zhim/ /'khums pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad brnag dgos so/ /bdun phrag bdun nas nyi shu rtsa drug bar/ /dbang po yan lag ba spu la sogs 'grub/ /bdun phrag sum cu rtsa drug bar snyed du/ /lus zungs brtas dang cher bskyed g.yo bar byed/ /de nas rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor brtsir ba'i bar/

/las kyi rlung gis mgo mjug slog pas btsa'/ /'chi bas nyen pa'i sdug bsngal bsdus 'joms 'dra/ /btsas nas reg pas pags pa bshus pa bzhin/ /khrus byas sha bur spu gris reg dang mtshungs/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal shin tu bzod dka' ba/ /lang tsho nyams pas kun gyi yid mi 'ong*/ /stod rmad mi theg 'khar ba la brten cing*/ /lus kyi drod nyams zas kyang 'ju bar dka'/ /mthu stobs nyams pas 'gro 'dug bsgul bskyod dka'/ /'dod sar mi phyin lhu tshigs rnam par 'gyur/ /dbang po nyams pas mig 'grib gzugs mi mthong/ /sgra skad mi thos dri ro reg mi tshor/ /dran pa mi gsal gti mug gnyid du bying/ /yul gyi longs spyod nyams pas yon tan chung*/ / zas sogs zhim po'ang de las log par snang*/ /tshe nyams 'chi bas 'jigs dang 'du shes 'khrug /byis bzhin bzod stobs chung la bsran mi bzod/ / snum zad mar me ji bzhin myur du 'gro/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal shin tu bzod dka' ba/ /lus kyi rang bzhin 'gyur dang yid mi bde/ /yul gyi longs spyod yid du mi 'ong zhing*/ / srog dang bral bar dogs pas mya ngan skye/ /sdug bsngal mi bzod smre sngags 'byin par byed/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal shin tu chen po yang*/ /zas gos gtam dang mal gyi tha mar nyal/ /srog lus 'khor g.yog gnyen 'dun longs spyod 'dor/ /gcig pu sa tshugs med par 'gro bas 'jigs/ /mi sdug pa dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal yang*/ /yid du mi 'ong gnod 'tshe'i 'jigs pas nyen/ / byams shing sdug pa'i yul dang bral ba yang*/ /mya ngan smre sngags yid mi bde ba'i gzhi/ /yon tan rjes dran 'dod pas gdung bar byed/ /'dod pa rnams kyis phongs pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ / don ma grub pas sems kyi zug rngu ldang*/ / dbul bas nyam thag bkres skom yi dgas 'dra/ /gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes te/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po yang*/

/zag bcas nyid phyir sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas/ / rten dang snod dang 'byung khungs lags par gsungs/ /de ltar mi yi 'jig rten mtha' dag na'ang/ /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras nyid phyir bde ba med/ /de las thar phyir legs pa'i chos bsams te/ /'khor ba'i gnas las thar pa'i thabs 'tshal lo/ /lha min rnams la'ang bde ba'i skabs med de/ /don med 'thab rtsod 'khrug cing zhe sdang la/ /lha yi dpal la mi bzod phrag dog ldan/ /g.yul ngor sdug bsngal brgya phrag brten 'tshal lo/ / de bas dge legs zhi ba'i 'gro ba dag /myur ba nyid du thar pa'i chos mdzod cig /'dod lha'i gnas na'ang sdug bsngal tshad med de/ /bag med 'dod pas myos dang 'chi 'pho ltung*/ /me tog rnying dang stan la nyams mi dga'/ /grogs kyis spong dang phyi ma'i gnas la 'jigs/ /tshor ba mi bzad lha yi zhag bdun 'byung*/ /tshangs ris la sogs gzugs khams bsam gtan lha/ /snga ma'i las zad srid pa 'og mar ltung*/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal mthong nas sdug bsngal la/ /gzugs med zhi gnas las zad tshul mthong nas/ /srid pa phyi mar 'du byed sdug bsngal ldan/ /mtho ris thob kyang yid brtan mi rung bas/ /bskal bzang rnams kyis thar pa bsgrub par bya/ /'khor ba'i bde la chags pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /me yi 'obs su sred pas gdungs bar zad/ /'di ltar thar pa rang la rag las shing*/ /thar pa'i thabs ni lha mi'i ston pas gsungs/ /gzhan gyis glo bur 'byin pa'i skabs med de/ /gnyid myos rmi lam sus kyang dgag med bzhin/ /gal te nus na bde gshegs sras bcas kyi/ /thugs rje'i zer gyis 'khor ba stongs zin nges/ /de bas rang nyid brtson pa'i go bgos te/ /thar lam 'dzeg la brtson pa'i dus la bab/ / grangs med 'das pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis/ /gso ba'i spyod yul ma gyur bdag lta bu/ /sdig pa'i rang bzhin srid lam dgon par 'khyams/ /sngar bzhin brtson pa med na yang dang yang*/

'gro drug gnas su sdug bsngal byed 'di soms/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mkha' ltar mtha' yas shing*/ /me ltar mi bzad yul ltar sna tshogs la/ / bzod pa'i sems khyod gnas min smad pa'i gnas/ /ngo tsha mi shes khrel bag bral ba la/ /thugs rje'i go skabs 'jug par ga la 'gyur/ /thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i phrin las de yang ni/ /gdul bya'i las rkyen dag las 'byung bar gsungs/ /de bas rang gi nyes kun shes byas te/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal snying nas dran byas la/ / bdag dang 'gro kun srid las thar bya'i phyir/ /zhi ba'i lam la yang dag 'dzeg par gyis/ /da lta'i sdug bsngal cung zad mi bzod na/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad ji ltar bzod/ /de ltar bshad kyang cung zad mi skyo ba/ /bdag snying lcags kyi gar bu chen po'am/ /rdo yi khams bzhin sems pa med par mngon/ /'khor ba mi bzad sdug bsngal can phung po/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs kun nyon mongs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma'i 'byung khungs la/ /sems shes su zhig sred pa 'phel bar byed/ /de bas myur du srid las rgyal bar mdzod/ /de ltar bde 'byung chos kyi dga' ston gyis/ /grong khyer gsum gyi 'gro ba ji snyed kun/ /bde dga'i shas 'tsho sna tshogs sdug bsngal gyis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// // de ltar srid pa'i bde sdug mtho dman rnams/ /sngon bsags las las byung bar thub pas gsungs/ /'khor bar 'du byed las de dkar nag gnyis/ / dge dang mi dge bcu bcu'i rang bzhin no/ /de yi rten gzhi kun gzhi lung ma bstan/ /me long dang 'dra rtog med ngo bo'i stong*/ /shes pa gsal la yul du mi rtog cing*/ /'char gzhi byed pas me long dngas dang 'dra/ /de las gzugs sogs yul 'dzin dbang shes lnga/ /rang ngo mi rtog me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/

/de rjes gzung 'dzin yul 'byed shes pa rnams/ /skad cig rjes 'thud de la 'dzin mi 'dzin/ /rtog dang mi rtog nyon yid yid shes te/ /de yang chags rtog rags pa'i dge sdig gis/ /'dod par 'du byed bag chags kun gzhir brten/ /mi rtog gsal snang gzugs su 'du byed la/ /mi rtog rtse gcig gzugs med bag chags brten/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin glo bur sgrib pa gnyis/ /dus rnams kun du nye bar brten pa yin/ /shes pa gang du'ang mi rtog yengs thabs tshe/ /snang yul mi 'dzin rtse gcig kun gzhi'i dus/ /gsal snang gang la'ang der 'dzin mi 'jug pa/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes dngas gsal g.yo ba med/ /sgo lnga'i yul dang dgag sgrub gzung 'dzin gyis/ /tshogs bdun yul la rags par rtog pa na/ /rnam shes bdun zhes nye bar btagasas pa yin/ / 'di dag goms pas khams gsum srid pa ru/ /sgo gsum 'khrul zhing sdug bsngal 'du byed yin/ /de yang 'dod par tshogs bdun gtso bo la/ /gzugs su kun gzhi'i rnam shes gzugs med du/ /mi rtog kun gzhi 'ba' zhig gtso bor ldan/ /gzhan gnyis 'khor gyi tshul du bag la nyal/ /rang rang sa der ldan par shes par bya/ /'di ltar 'dod na mtshan mo nyal ba'i tshe/ /yul lnga'i shes pa rim gyis yid du thim/ /de yang kun gzhir thim pas mi rtog pa/ /rtse gcig snang yul med pa'i ngang de nyid/ /chos dbyings thim pas rang bzhin spros dang bral/ / slar yang mched pas kun gzhi'i rnam shes las/ /yid nyid gcig pu langs pas rmi lam sems/ /sna tshogs dgag sgrub med bzhin snang ba byed/ /de las mched pas gnyid sad tshogs drug gi /rnam shes yul la 'jug pas las 'du byed/ /nyin mtshan khor yug de ltar snang ba yin/ /gzugs su rang sa'i shes pa bsam gtan bzhi/ /kun gzhi'i shes nyid ngang du gnas pa las/ /yul rnams 'dzin pa'i shes pa phra mo rnams/ /skabs 'gar nye bar 'byung gis phal cher ni/

/ting 'dzin goms pas nye bar gnas pa yin/ / gzugs med rang sa'i shes pa kun gzhi'i ngang/ /mkha' sogs rnam bzh-i zhi gnas rtse gcig tu/ / nye bar gnas pas shin tu phra ba yi/ /tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam par shes/ /ming bzhi'i phung por sems kyi rgyud brten nas/ /zhi gnas rtse gcig bskal par mi sad de/ /rnam dpyod dge ba'i sa bon 'debs pa'ang med/ /de ltar bsam gtan gzugs med sems de yang*/ /snga ma'i 'bras yin zad nas tshe 'pho la/ /ngo bo lung ma bstan yin gti mug phyir/ /'khor ba'i gnas su phyin ci log rgyu 'bras/ /yang yang bskyed phyir de las thar dgos so/ /'dod pa'i sems de goms tshul ji bzhin nyid/ /yin phyir mtho dman thar pa'i rgyu yang byed/ /nyin dus phal cher tshogs bdun shes pa gtso/ /gzhan gnyis ngo bo gcig pa'i 'khor du yod/ /de yang gzugs 'dzin mig gi rnam shes te/ /der gsal rtog bral cha ni kun gzhi'i shes/ /de yi mi rtog cha nyid kun gzhi 'o/ / lhag ma drug kyang de bzhin shes par bya/ /gnyid du rtse gcig rmi lam sad dus na/ /kun gzhi kun gzhi'i rnam shes yid dang ni/ /tshogs drug rim bzhin gcig dang gnyis gcig dang*/ thams cad ngo bo gcig pa'i dus shes bya/ /rten chos las kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa/ /ngo bo 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ / des bskyed srid par 'du byed dkar nag gnyis/ /'khor bar mtho dman ltung phyir mi dge ba/ / dbye na bcu nyid so sor snang ba yin/ /mi dge'i las bcu lus gsum ngag gi bzhi/ /yid gsum rim bzhin so sor dbye ba ni/ /srog gcod bsams bzhin ma nor gzhan bas dal/ phyogs mthun rdeg 'tshog la sogs srog la 'tshe/ /ma byin len pa gzhan nor brku ba ste/ /phyogs mthun g.yo sgyus pha rol nor la len/ /'dod log gzhan gyis bdag bzung ny-id la spyod*/ / phyogs mthun bgrod min rtsol sogs 'khrig pa'i chos/

/brdzun tshig 'du byed gzhan bsgyur tshig don go /phyogs mthun drang sogs gzhan sems slu ba nyid/ /phra ma pha rol 'byed tshig smra ba ste/ /phyogs mthun gzhan tshig gzhan zlos mi mthun byed/ /ngag 'khyal bstan bcos ngan dang bre mo'i gtam/ / phyogs mthun 'brel med brjod sogs chos min gtam/ /tshig rtsub pha rol zher 'debs rtsub mo'i tshig /phyogs mthun 'jam sogs gzhan yid mi bde'i gtam/ /brnab sems gzhan 'byor mi bzod bdag gir byed/ / phyogs mthun thos sogs pha rol dpal la brkam/ /gnod sems gzhan la gnod 'tshes zhe sdang zhing*/ /phyogs mthun phan par mi 'dod khro ba'i sems/ /log lta rtag chad rgyu 'bras med par blta/ /phyogs mthun sgro skur 'debs sogs phyin ci log /yul dang kun slong bsam sbyor ngan ba yis/ / mi dge'i las bcu spyad pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /rnam sm-in rgyu mthun dbang dang byed pa bzhi/ /las bcu chung ngus dud 'gro 'bring yi dgas/ /chen pos dmyal bar sdug bsngal rnam snin 'bras/ /rgyu mthun gny-is las gang byed der skye ba/ /byed pa rgyu mthun 'bras bu lags par gsungs/ /mtho ris thob na'ang tshe thung nad mang zhing*/ /yo byad mi 'byor dgra dang thun mong 'gyur/ /khyim thab mi mdzes dgra zlar 'gyur ba dang*/ /skur pa mang la gzhan gyis slu ba dang*/ /g.yog 'khor mi 'dum 'khor g.yog ngan pa dang*/ /mi snyan thos dang 'thab mo'i tshig tu 'gyur/ /tshig gzung mi 'os ma nges spobs pa dang*/ /chog mi shes dang 'dod pa che bar 'gyur/ /phan pa mi tshol gzhan gyis gnod pa'i gnas/ /lta ba ngan dag g.yo sgyu che ba ste/ /mi dge bcu la rim bzhin gnyis gnyis ldan/ /myong ba rgyu mthun 'bras bu lags par gsungs/ /dbang gi 'bras bu phyi rol yul la smin/ /de yang ma dag gzhan dbang gnas skabs 'dir/ /srog bcad pas ni sa phyogs gzi brjid chung*/ / sman shing lo 'bras me tog bza' btung sogs/

/mthu chung 'ju dka' tshe la bar du gcod/ /ma byin len pas lo thog 'bras mi smin/ /sad ser mu ges 'jigs pa'i yul du skye/ /log par g.yem pas bshang gci 'dam rdzab khrod/ /ljan ljin mi gtsang dri nga skye ba'i yul/ /dog cing nyam nga nyams mi dga' bar skye/ /brdzun gyis yul rnams mi mthun 'jigs dang bcas/ /'byor pa g.yo zhing gzhan gyis slu bar skye/ /phra mas sa phyogs bgrod dka' mtho dman can/ /ngam grogs g.yang sa gcong rong la sogs pa/ /reg na me bde sna tshogs yul du skye/ /rtsub mos sdong dum rdog sreg tsher ma dang*/ /rdul dang nyal nyil 'bras ngan rtsub pa dang*/ /tsha sgo la sogs mi dge'i yul du skye/ /bkyal pas lo 'bras mi smin dus tshigs log /ring du mi brtan mi gnas yul du skye/ /brnab sems 'bras sogs nyung zhing sbun pa mang*/ /bzang po'i dus tshigs 'gyur ba mthong bar skye/ /gnod sems lo thog 'bras bu tsha zhing kha/ / rgyal po chom rkun mi rgod sbrul la sogs/ /rang bzhin gnod pa mang ba'i yul du skye/ /log ltas rin chen 'byung khungs mi ldan zhing*/ /sman shing me tog 'bras bu nyung ba dang*/ /skyabs dang skyobs pa dpung gnyen med par skye/ /skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu mi dge ba/ /gang byas de nyid 'phel bas sdug bsngal bskyed/ / mdor na rang bzhin mi dge bcu po rnams/ /dug dang 'dra ste gang gis longs spyod pa/ /che 'bring chung ngus sdug bsngal cher bskyed pas/ /dgra bzhin rab tu spang pa 'bad 'tshal lo/ /mtho ris 'phen pa dge ba'i las bcu yang*/ /mi dge bcu spong sems pa dge ba ste/ /srog mi gcod dang ma byin len pa spangs/ / log par mi g.yem brdzun dang phra ma spong*/ /ngag 'khyal tshig rtsub mi smra brnab sems med/ /gnod sems log lta ring du spangs pa ste/ /chung ngus mi dang 'bring gis 'dod pa'i lha/ /chen pos bsam gtan gzugs med ting 'dzin 'brel/

/gong ma'i khams gnyis bde ba 'dzin par byed/ /'bras bu bzhi ste sngar gyi ldog pa'i dpes/ /dge bcu'i 'bras bu mtho ris shes par bya/ /de ltar dge ba bsod nams cha mthun bcus/ /bde 'gror 'phen zhing rang bzhin mi dge bcus/ /ngan 'gror ltung ba'i rgyu 'bras dkar nag las/ / blang dor byed pa 'jig rten dge ba'i lam/ /lha mi'i theg pa lags par thub pas gsungs/ /'dis ni phyi mar bde 'gro bsgrubs pas na/ /thar pa'i rten du yang dag gzhag par mdzad/ /legs ldan 'gro ba rnams kyis bsten par mdzod/ / thar pa'i dge mchog 'khor ba ring du byed/ /de yang srid par 'du byaid mtho dman las/ /dkar nag gnyis ka las 'das zhi la gzhol/ / thar pa'i cha mthun la sogs zag med rgyu/ /dge ba bcu dang bsam gtam gzugs med dang*/ /pha rol phyin drug la sogs lam lngas bsdus/ /de yang gang zag chos bdag med rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab zung 'brel dge ba yis/ /srid zhir mi gnas 'gro ba'i don byed cing*/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang mtha' yas bsgrub pas na/ /rnal 'byor dge ba 'jig rten kun las 'das/ /de yang dmigs bcas bsod nams tshogs yin la/ /dmigs med ye shes tshogs te zung 'brel gyis/ /sgrib gnyis sbyangs nas sku gnyis mngon du byed/ /de yang so so skye bo'i zag bcas te/ /'phags pa'i zag med mnyam rjes spyod yul can/ / rim bzhin spyad pas thar pa thob pa yin/ /thar pa dge ba'i rten ni rigs yin la/ /de yang sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /dri med khams te rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs/ /de yi snang cha sku gnyis dpe rnam dgu/ /snying rje'i rang bzhi'i ye nas gnas pa ni/ /rgyas 'gyur rigs zhes bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ /rtsa ba rig pa'i ye shes 'od gsal la/ /ngo bo dug gsum med pas dge ba yin/ /rigs de sad las sems gnyis rab bskyed dus/ /snying rje mngon bsgrubs kun rdzob bsod nams tshogs/

/bum sogs gsum dbang bskyed rim dag pa ste/ / stong pa rang bzhin don dam ye shes tshogs/ /bzhi pa tshig dbang rdzogs rim phyag rgya che/ /legs par bsgoms shing rim gnyis spel ba yis/ /nyon mongs ye shes gnas gyur dge ba rnams/ /ches cher 'phel bas khams kyi sgrib sbyangs te/ /chos gzugs dri med nyi ma mthong bar 'gyur/ / 'jig rten chos rab dge ba rnam pa bcu/ /bsam gtan gzugs med la sogs snang bcas tshogs/ /'jig rten 'das gang shin tu spros pa med/ /don dam ye shes tshogs te mnyam rjes yul/ /zung du 'brel par spyad las legs dgu 'grub/ /de yang srid par 'du byed dge ba ltar/ /zhi bar 'du byed tshul gyis las su bshad/ /srid las 'da' phyir las las thar pa lags/ /lam zhugs dge ba bcu yi 'bras bu yang*/ /rnam smin rgyu mthun dbang dang byed las te/ /de dag chung 'bring chen por spyad pa yis/ /gnas skabs lha mi mthar thug nges legs 'gyur/ /rgyu mthun byed pas ngang gis dge la gzhol/ /myong bas tshe ring ba dang longs spyod che/ /mthun pa'i khyim thab dgra zla med pa dang*/ /skur pa mi 'byung phan tshun mdza' bshes bzhin/ /tshig gzung 'os dang kun gyi rna bar snyan/ /chog shes byams ldan lta ba bzang po 'gyur/ /dbang gis yul bzang gzi brjid phun su tshogs/ /bza' btung sman sogs 'ju sla mthu che zhing*/ / phyogs gtsang sman sogs dri zhim ngad dang ldan/ /gzhan gyis mi slu 'jigs bral gnod 'tshe med/ /skye dgu mthun dang reg na mchog tu bde/ /dus kyi rjes 'gro legs smin 'bras bus phyug /sa phyogs mnyam la mtsho bsil rdzing bus brgyan/ /me tog 'bras mang bzang dgu 'phel ba mthong*/ /lo 'bras smin sogs ro mchog bda' ba dang*/ /'byung khungs bzang zhing dpung gnyen ldan par skye/ /skyes bu byed pa dge las dge 'phel bas/ /legs dgu'i bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa yin/ / gzhan yang sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis

bde/ /bzod pas gzugs bzang brtson 'grus yon tan brjid/ /bsam gtan sems zhi blo yis grol ba 'thob/ /byams pas yid 'ong snying rjes phan pa 'grub/ /dga' bas phun tshogs btang snyoms rnyog pa med/ /mdor na bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab 'bras/ /gnas skabs mngon mtho mthar thug nges legs 'grub/ / 'di ni lam bzang shing rta chen po'i srol/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i phun tshogs sgrub byed yin/ /de ltar srid zhir 'du byed las rnams ni/ / sems la brton zhing sems nyid 'od gsal la/ /mkha' bzhin byed po mi dmigasas spros dang bral/ /bden pa gnyis don rten cing 'brel par 'byung*/ / gdod nas rnam dag med bzhin snang ba yi/ /las ni kun byed ri mo mkhan 'dra zhing*/ /rtag tu rjes 'gro lus kyi grib ma 'dra/ /gzhan du mi 'pho lus kyi bde sdug bzhin/ /rang bzhin bzlog dka' chu klung 'bab 'dra zhing*/ /mtho dman ltung byed 'gro kun dbang po 'dra/ /shin tu rgya che nam mkha'i dbyings 'dra zhing*/ /dkar nag mi 'gyur kunda utpal 'dra/ /las rnams brtags na ngo bo 'ga' med kyang*/ /rmi lam bzhin du bde sdug sna tshogs byed/ /blos btags las rnams dngos po mtshan ma med/ /rgyu 'bras mi slu rten 'brel zab mo nyid/ / yod min med min rang bzhin gnyis su med/ /ji ltar spyad pa de ltar rnam par smin/ /'di ni ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa'i yul/ /rnam kun mkhyen pa de yis legs par gsungs*/ /gang zhig las 'bras khyad du gsod pa dag / mu stegs chad par lta ba'i slob ma ste/ /stong pa'i lta ba gdeng tsam su 'char ba/ /

chad pa'i mthar lhung 'og nas 'og tu 'gro/ /lam ngan zhugs pa de dag gnas ngan las/ /nam yang mi thar bde 'gro ring du byed/ /rgyu 'bras snying rje bsod nams tshogs 'di dag /drang don byis pa'i chos te sangs mi rgya/ / nges don byar med nam mkha' lta bu'i don/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnams kyis bsgom shig lo/ /chad pa las kyang chad pa'i lta ba can/ /dman pa las kyang dman pa'i lam zhugs dag /rgyu nyid bgag nas 'bras bu bsgrub pa mtshar/ /nam mkha' yin na bsgoms yang ci zhig dgos/ /min na bsgoms kyang ngal ba don med do/ /cang med bsgoms pas thar pa thob 'gyur na/ /nam mkha'i yid can rnams kyang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /bsgoms par khas blangs nas kyang rgyu 'bras grub/ /de phyir lam ngan de 'dra rgyang srings shig / yang dag lam ni rgyu 'bras rten 'brel te/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor lhun gyis grub/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i las 'bras kyis/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i lam bsgoms te/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i 'bras bu 'thob/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sems can don/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i mdzad pa ni/ /dag pa'i rgyu 'bras zab mo'i rten 'brel yin/ /de bas nges don mdo rgyud snying po'i don/ / tshogs gnyis zung 'jug rim gnyis bskyed rdzogs kyis/ /myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub byed yin/ /'dir ni srid par 'du byed rgyu 'bras kun/ /cha dang bcas pa ma lus rab spangs nas/ /thar pa'i rgyu 'bras nan tan snying por bya/ /myur du mngon mtho nges legs byang chub 'grub/ /de ltar bde chen chos kyi char bsil bas/ /'gro sems sa gzhir tshogs gnyis rab brgyas te/ /las dang nyon mongs yongs gang srid pa 'dir/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /las rgyu 'bras kyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // de ltar las 'bras ma nor legs pa'i lam/

/dam pa rnams la nye bar brten las 'byung*/ /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang tshogs/ /byang chub gsum brnyes dge ba'i bshes las byung*/ /srid na mngon mtho bde ba'i shas thob pa/ /de yang dam pa dag la brten nas 'byung*/ /de phyir skyes bu dam pa bsten par bya/ /ji ltar tsandan shing la 'khri shing dang*/ /mi gtsang 'dam du brten pa'i ku sha ltar*/ /dam pa bsten pas rang nyid dam par 'gyur/ /ngan pa bstan pas rang nyid ngan par 'gyur/ /de phyir skyes bu dam pa bsten pa dang*/ / sdig pa'i bshes gnyen spangs la nan tan bya/ /dam pa de yang chos tshul du zhe na/ /'jig rten 'dren phyir kun dang cha mthun la/ / 'jig rten 'das phyir kun dang cha mi mthun/ /sgo gsum spyod pa kun las khyad par 'phags/ /zhi sku kun spyod gtsang zhing skyon med la/ /the tshom gcod mkhas gsung snyan dri ma med/ /thugs ni zab zhi kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod/ /yon tan mtha' yas thos dang snying rje che/ /shes rab rgya che dgongs spyod nam mkha' 'dra/ /phrin las tshad med 'brel tshad don dang ldan/ /byams ldan skyo ngal spangs shing rtag tu brtson/ /'gro ba'i kha lo gyen du bsgyur la brten/ khyad par gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /dbang dang sdom pa dam tshig gtsang ldan zhing*/ /rgyud don man ngag rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor 'phrin las mnga' brnyes shing*/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras nyams rtags drod tshad thob/ /brtse chen thabs mkhas gdul bya smin grol 'god/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs sprin phung ma yal ba/ /de 'dra'i mkhas grub dpal ldan bla ma bsten/ /gang gi yon tan shin tu mtha' yas te/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gyur phyogs tsam rab bsngags na/ /srid mtsho sgrol bas gru chen mnyen pa ste/ /lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon bla na med/ /rgud pa sel bas yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /las dang nyon mongs me 'jil bdud rtsi'i chu/

/ chos char bsil bas char sprin bzang po ste/ /'gro kun dga' bskyed lha yi rnga bo che/ /dug gsum nad sel sman pa'i rgyal po ste/ /ma rig mun sel sgron me 'od po che/ /skye dgu'i bde 'byung dpag bsam shing chen te/ 'dod dgu lhun grub rin chen bum pa bzang*/ /byams chen nyi ma 'od zer dpag med de/ /gdung sel zla ba phan bde'i 'od dkar can/ /dgongs klong yangs pas dri med mkha' 'dra la/ /ting 'dzin 'od gsal gza' skar lhun grub 'dra/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin dpag med mtsho 'dra zhing*/ /thugs rje'i rlabs chen g.yo bas chu klung 'dra/ /rnam g.yeng mi bskyod gangs ri'i dpal 'dra zhing*/ /mchog tu mi g.yo ri rgyal lhun po 'dra/ /srid gnas mi gos 'dam skyes pad 'dra zhing*/ /kun la thugs snyoms byams sdug pha ma 'dra/ / yon tan mtha' yas rin chen gter 'dra zhing*/ /'jig rten 'dren pas rgyal ba'i dbang po 'dra/ /de 'dra'i bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi rje/ /gang na bzhugs rnams sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /mthong thos dran reg 'khor ba phyir bsnyil zhing*/ / rlabs chen phrin las khur chen dpag tu med/ /sa chen 'gro ba kun gyi rten bzhin no/ /dkon mchog bzhi pa bla ma sangs rgyas te/ / dkyil 'khor dbang phyug he ru ka dpal nyid/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba gdul dka'i don mdzad pas/ /gdul bya'i ngor ni sangs rgyas kun bas lhag / dngos grub rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon la/ /sgo gsum zol med gtsang ma'i spyi bos bsten/ /de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i lam 'gog cing*/ /bde 'gro'i skas 'dzugs 'di phyir phan bde mdzad/ /yang dag don ston sems rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'dir smin grol lam la 'god pas na/ /rtag brtan 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dad pa yis/ /dus rnams kun du skyo ngal med par bsten/ /ji ltar nad pas sman pa'i rgyal po dang*/ /dmangs kyi rgyal po 'gron pos skyel ma dang*/

/tshong pas ded dpon grub pas gnyen pa ltar/ /nyon mongs zhi phyir nyes kun gnod bral phyi/ /skye shis 'jigs phyir don gnyis lhun grub phyir/ /srid mtsho brgal phyir bla ma bsten par bya/ /bla ma sman pa gdams ngag sman dang ni/ /rang la nad pa'i 'du shes nyer gzhag ste/ /nan tan brtson pa sman nyid bsten tshul dang*/ /zhi bde nad las grol ba'i 'bras thob bzhin/ /bsten tshul gzhan rnams tshul des dpag byas la/ /dag pa'i 'du shes bzhi yis bsten par bya/ /gzhan du skal ngan slob ma nyes kun gzhi/ / dad dang ngo tsha khrel med snying rje chung*/ /rigs dang rang bzhin kun spyod skal pa ngan/ /sems dang las dang nyon mongs dug lnga rags/ /chos dang chos min dge sdig bslab pa 'chal/ /sdom dang dam tshig mi bsrung gnyen po med/ /rab rmongs blo gros chung zhing dgang dka' ba/ khro dang tshig rtsun 'phel ba de dag gis/ /bla ma ri dgas chos la gla rtsi dang*/ /rang la rngon pa nan tan mda' 'phen dang*/ /chos grub 'bras bu gzhan du 'tshong ba'i tshul/ /'du shes log pa lnga yis bsten pa ni/ /dam tshig med pas 'di phyir sdug bsngal 'thob/ /la las thog mar ma brtags bab col 'jug /gsar nges yon tan brjod cing phyi nas smod/ kha cig 'dres mas ngo lkog ngan g.yo'i tshul/ /zur gyis bla ma nye 'khor sun 'byin pa/ /de dag gis ni 'bras bu mnar med nyid/ /skal bzang slob ma dad dang shes rab che/ /brtson 'grus bag yod dran dang shes bzhin ldan/ /bka' las mi 'da' sdom dang dam tshig bsrung*/ /sgo gsum dul zhing snying rje phan sems che/ khong yangs spro ring gtong phod dag snang che/ /brtan zhing mos gus che ba de dag gis/ /rtag tu bla ma'i yon tan dran bya zhing*/ /skyon la mi rtog mthong yang yon tan bsam/ /rang snang yin nges khong la mi mnga' zhes/ /snying nas bsam zhing bshags bsdam gnyen po bsten/ /bla ma mi mnyes cha dang bcas spang zhing*/

/ ji ltar mnyes pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ /bla mas bka' stsal nam yang mi bcag cing*/ /bla ma'i nye 'khor sdug pa'ang bla ma bzhin/ /bla ma'i 'khor g.yog slob mar mi bsdu zhing*/ /chos bshad dbang bskur la sogs zhus te bya/ /bla ma'i spyan sngar lus ngag yid bsdam zhing*/ /rkang pa brkyang dang skyil krung rgyab mi bstan/ /ngo 'dzum mi gnag khro gnyer bstan mi bya/ /bab col mi smra rdzun tshig phra ma dang*/ /gzhan gyi skyon brjod mi snyan rtsub mo'i tshig /ma brtags 'brel pa med rnams smra mi bya/ /bla ma'i rdzas la brnab sems mi bya zhing/ /sder bcas gnod sems cha dang bcas kun bsdam/ /bla ma'i mdzad spyod sna tshogs cho 'phrul la/ kha zhe 'dzol bas 'khrul par mi brtag cing*/ / 'di ni mi rigs khong rang mdzad mod snyam/ /cung zad 'gal 'du nyes skyon log lta dor/ /gal te bla ma sdang bar mngon na yang*/ /rang skyon yod nges brtags la bshags bsdam bya/ /spyi gtsug bsgoms la gsol ba drag po gdab/ /de yis mnyes shing dngos grub myur du 'thob/ /bla ma mthong tshe ldang dang phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /bzhugs tshe stan sogs mkho ba'i yo byad dbul/ / snyan par smra bas bstod cing thal mo sbyor/ /bzhud tshe ldang dang zhabs 'bring bsnyen bkur bya/ /rtag tu dran dang shes bzhin bag yod cing*/ /gus dang 'jigs bcas zhum pas gnas par bya/ /ji ltar bag ma gsar pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /sgo gsum zhi bas bla ma'i drung 'dug gis/ /'phyar zhing g.yeng la rgod bag bya ba min/ /phyogs ris ma yin khe dang grags pas min/ /g.yo sgyus ma yin de bzhin tshul 'chos min/ /ngo lkog ma yin nye ring chags sdag min/ /rang la 'byor pa yod na bla ma mchod/ /lus ngag zhabs tog bsnyen kur sri zhu dang*/ /tshe 'di blo btang bsgrub pas mnyes par bya/ /gzhan gyis mi snyan brjod na'ang de bzlog cing*/ /nus pa med na slar yang yon tan bsam/ /rna ba dgab cing snying rjes phan pa bsgrub/

/de la mi brten bag phebs smra ba min/ /des na tshe rabs kun tu phan pa 'grub/ /dam pa rnams dang phrad cing chos rab thos/ /sa dang lam dang gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin/ / sna tshogs yon tan 'byor pas yongs gang zhing*/ /'gro la zhi bde'i dga' ston 'gyed pa yin/ /de lta dam pa rnams la legs brten pas/ /sdig pa'i bshes gnyen ngan pa'ang kun du spang*/ /de yang sngar bshad yon tan mi ldan zhing*/ /log pa'i skyon mang sdom dang dam tshig 'chal/ /byams dang snying rje shes rab thos pa chung*/ /le lo snyom lam mi shes nga rgyal che/ /ko long gdug rtsub nyon mongs dug lnga rags/ /tshe 'di don gnyer phyi ma rgyang ring 'phang*/ chos ltar ston yang chos min zog po'i rigs/ /mi gtsang phung po lta bu'i bla ma ni/ /gdul bya'i bung ba mang yang ring du spang*/ /dad ldan log lam ngan 'gror 'khrid pas na/ /thar lam 'dod pas nam yang bsten mi bya/ /sdig pa'i grogs po de yi spang bya ste/ /ji tsam 'grogs pa de tsam sdig pa 'phel/ / dge ba 'grib cing nyon mongs char bzhin 'bab/ /bde 'gro 'gog cing ngan 'gro'i 'bab stegs te/ /dam pa smod cing dkar po'i chos la sdang*/ /ngan pa bstod cing nag po'i chos la bsten/ / skal mnyam mi dge spyod rnams bsngags pa ste/ /rtag tu log lam ngan 'gror 'khrid pas na/ /blo mig ldan pas ring du spang bar bya/ /sdig pa'i bshes gnyen grogs bcas spangs pa yis/ /'di phyir bde zhing legs pa'i yon tan 'grub/ /rtag tu dge 'phel thar lam zab mo zin/ /skye bo ngan pa nam yang mi mthong zhing*/ /bde gshegs sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po yis/ /bdag la dgongs shing byin gyis rlob par mthong*/ /bde bar tshe yi dus byed mtho ris 'gro/ /de sogs bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /dge ba'i grogs po dam pa rtag tu bsten/ /de dag gis ni dge ba'i las 'phel zhing*/ /sdig dang nyon mongs 'grib la nyes pa 'gog

/srid las mthar 'byin mngon mtho nges legs 'grub/ /tshe 'dir bde zhing phyi ma 'bras dang bcas/ /rtag tu don yod lha mi'i 'dren par 'gyur/ /dge ba'i bshes dang dge grogs bsten pa yis/ / dge tshogs 'phel zhing 'bras bu bde ba 'thob/ /srid na mi 'jigs phan bde dpag med cing*/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis 'byor ba mtha' yas 'grub/ 'di ni rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i sprul pa ste/ /snyigs ma'i dus su de ltar snang ba yin/ /de bas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /skye bo dam pa rnams la brten par bya/ /de yis dag snang phyogs med 'char ba dang*/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs shing*/ /nyams dang rtogs pa rang bzhin gong du 'phel/ /gzhan don dpag med ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub/ /ji ltar bsgom zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /rgyun du tshogs bsag sgrib pa sbyong ba la/ /nyin mo spyi gtsugs mtshan mo snying nang du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma gang mos yi dam dang*/ /mkha' 'gro gnyis med mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i mthar/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor/ /yid kyis mchod cing 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ /mtshan de rgya skad thog mar oṃ sbyin zhing*/ /tha mar āḥhūm̐ gang 'dod sham bur gdags/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi bar 'dod pa yis/ /thams cad dkar po 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ /mi mthun phyogs zhi dngos grub thob par bsam/ /tshe dpal 'byor sogs rgyas pa'i las 'dod pas/ /ser po 'dod dgu'i char pa 'bebs pa bsam/ /dbang dang dgugs pa la sogs dpang rnams la/ /thams cad dmar po 'od zer lcags kyu'i tshul/ /bgegs dang gnod sogs tshar gcod mngon spyod la/ /thams cad mthing nag 'od zer mtshon cha 'phro/ /med dpung rtsibs stong 'khor los 'joms par bsam/ /sngags bzlas stong gsum g.yo 'gul ldeg cing 'phar/ /las rnams grub cing lhag pa'i bskyed rim bsgom/ / rjes rnams rim bsdu mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang*/

/dar cig glod la dge ba byang chub bsngo/ /so so'i las dang rjes mthun rtags rnams 'byung*/ /'di ni zab lam bde chen rgya mtsho yin/ /khyad par nad gdon bar chad 'chi blu'i tshe/ / mdun gyi nam mkha' pad sdong seng ge'i khri/ /mi 'jigs yangs pa can steng bla ma dang*/ /sangs rgyas dbyer med 'dzums mdangs ldan pa la/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma byang sems mkha' 'gros bskor/ /'og tu rigs drug lan chags snying rje'i mgron/ /dus gsum pha ma 'khor ba'i sems can bsam/ /rang sems spyi gtsug hūm̐ 'thon dpa' bo'i sku/ /chu gri thod pa thogs pa'i rnam pa yis/ / lus kyi thod pa smin mtshams mdzod spur bcas/ /thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum steng bzhag pa'i nang*/ /lus kyi sha khrag rus pas khengs pa la/ /bdud brtsi char bab 'og nas me 'bar bas/ /thod pa stong gsum dang mnyam bdud rtsis khengs*/ /rang sems dpa' bo grangs med sprul pa yis/ /thod pas thams cad dus mnyam bdud rtsi bkye/ /zhi ba'i mgron mnyes tshogs rdzogs dngos grub thob/ /srid pa'i mgron mnyes thog med lan chags 'khor*/ khyad par gang gnod gdon mnyes bar chad zhi/ /thams cad mnyes pa'i 'od zer bdag la phog /nad zhi gdon zhi bar chad rang sar zhi/ /'chi ba slus shing dngos grub thob par bsam/ /rjes la thams cad mi dmigs sems kyi ngang*/ /sems nyid mi dmigs chos dbyings mnyam par gzhag /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dag pas bsngo ba bya/ /'dis ni mi mthun rkyen rnams zhi ba dang*/ / tshogs chen rab rdzogs sgrib kun bral ba ste/ /byin rlabs tshad med rtogs pa rgyud la skye/ /bdag 'dzin med cing nges 'byung blo sna thung*/ /bsam pa 'grub cing snang srid bla mar

'char/ /gnad gcod med cing 'chi ka'i 'od gsal 'grub/ /bar dor grol zhing don gnyis phun sum tshogs/ /de phyir bla ma bsgrub la nan tan bya/ /gang gis bskyed rim bskal par bsgoms pas kyang*/ / bla ma skad cig dran pa mchog tu gsungs*/ /dpal ldan 'byor pa dam pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /yon tan yongs gang phan bde'i sprin tshogs can/ /sa gsum bdud rtsi dam pa'i char 'dod pas/ /thugs rje'i ngang can rnams la brten par bya/ /thog med dus nas nye bar goms pa yi/ /yid mkha'i nyon mongs gdung ba zhi bya'i phyir/ /nor bzang rtag tu ngu bzhin chos tshol bas/ /skyo ngal spangs la dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /de ltar don spyod dbang po'i rgyud stong ldan/ /skal bzang rna ba'i bdud rtsir lhung ba las/ /nyes gyur log pa'i lam la brten pa yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// // de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen legs bsten nas/ /thar pa'i lam la rim gyis bslab par bya/ /lam rnams kun gyi gzhi rten skyabs su 'gro / skyes bu chung rnams ngan 'gros 'jigs pa ste/ /'bring gnyis srid pas 'jigs dang chen po rnams/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal cha dang bcas mthong nas/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mi bzod zhi bdes 'jigs/ /rgyal sras theg pa che rnams 'gro ba'i phyir/ /skyabs su 'gro byed gsum dang bsam pa gsum/ /phal pa mchog dang bla na med pa 'o/ /dus kyang bsam pa'i rjes 'gro chung ngu rnams/ /phyi ma'i bde 'bras bar du 'gro ba ste/ /'bring gnyis gnas skabs ji srid 'tsho ba dang*/ / mthar thug nyan rang 'bras thob bar du 'gro/ /mchog rnams byang chub bar du rtag 'gro zhing*/ /ye shes gzhal med bsam yas bar du 'o/ /yul rnams gnyis te thun mong rgyu dang ni/ /thun mong ma yin 'bras bu'i skyabs gnas gnyis/

/rgyu dang 'bras bur dam 'cha' de yang ni/ /dus gzhan 'grub 'dod rgyu yi theg pa dang*/ /da lta nyid grub rang sems 'bras bu'i tshul/ /rdo rje theg pa dag gi dbye bas bzhag /mtshan nyid theg las de nyid gsungs pa ni/ ming tsam mthun pas phyogs gcig nges par bya/ /rgyu yi yul ni dmigs bcas dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas sprul sku mchog yin mtshan dpes brgyan/ /chos rnam gnyis te dri med lung gi chos/ /mdo dang rgyud sde theg pa sna tshogs don/ / gsung rab yi ger snang ba'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /de yang mdo sde gsung rab bcu gnyis te/ /mdo sde dbyangs bsnyan lung bstan tshigs su bcad/ /ched brjod rtogs pa brjod dang de ltar byung*/ /gleng gzhi shin tu rgyas dang skyes rab bcas/ /gtan phab rmad du byung ba'i sde rnams so/ /rgyud ni bya spyod rnal 'byor thu pas rgyud/ / thabs shes gnyis med pha ma gnyis su med/ /nang pa sngags te rnal 'byor chen po 'o/ /de yi yi ge glegs bam la sogs yin/ /rtogs pa'i chod ni sa lam bskyed rdzogs te/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzin ye shes snying po can/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin thabs tshul dpag med do/ /de yang rab dga' dri med 'od byed pa/ /'od 'phro sbyang dka' mngon gyur ring du song*/ /mi g.yo legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ /slob pa'i sa bcu bcu gcig kun tu 'od/ / sprul sku'i sa ste rgyu yi theg pas bzhag /rdo rje'i theg par yon tan rigs dbye bas/ /bcu gnyis la sogs rnam gzhag dpag tu med/ /tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam lnga dang*/ /rim gnyis la sogs zab mo sems kyi yul/ / dam chos nyi ma dri med 'od mnga'o/ /dge 'dun nyan rang skyes bu zung bzhi dang*/ /rgyal sras sar gnas phyi ste mkha' 'gro dang*/ /gsang sngags rjes slob 'gro ba nang du 'dod/ /'di dag dmigs pa'i yul te nam mkhar bsam/ / khyad par bla ma sangs rgyas gtso bor 'dod/

/rnam pa dngos yid gsang bas rab mchod de/ /bdag dang 'gro kun gus pas thal sbyar zhing*/ / bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub bar du gzhan don skyabs su 'gro / snying khong rus pa'i gting nas yang yang bya/ /dgyes shing 'od zer bkye bas rang gzhan gyi/ /sgo gsum sgrib sbyongs dngos grub thob par bsam/ /de yis bsod nams tshogs rdzogs gzugs sku 'grub/ / mthar thug 'bras bu'i skyabs gnas chos sku ste/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs snying po don gyi lha/ /rang sems 'od gsal spros kun bral ba yin/ /de yi lam 'khyer skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ /rgyu yi thun rjes thams cad rang gi sems/ /don la 'gro bya 'gro byed gnyis med pas/ /ji bzhin ngang la de bzhin mnyam par gzhag /yul sems gnyis su 'dzin na mthar thug min/ /'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro smon pa med pa yin/ /des ni ye shes tshogs rdzogs chos sku 'thob/ /rjes snang rmi lam sgyu mar bsngo ba bya/ / bslab bya gnyis las rgyu yi rim pa ni/ /srog dang rgyal srid bya dga' la sogs phyir/ /bla ma dang ni dkon mchog spang mi bya/ /bla mar skyabs song mchod 'os mi slu zhing*/ /dam pa rnams la skur 'debs mi snyan spang*/ /sangs rgyas skyabs song lha gzhan phyag mi btsal/ /chos la skyabs song sems can 'tshe ba spang*/ /dge 'dun skyabs song mu stegs can mi 'grogs/ /de dag gzugs la'ang dad pas rab mchod cing*/ /nyin mtshan rjes dran rtag par skyabs su 'gro/ /'bras bu'i bslab bya mnyam nyid nan tan bya*/ /bzang ngan mi rtog mchog dman blang dor min/ /spros la mi brten chos nyid gnyug mar sbyang*/ /thams cad lhun rdzogs dkyil 'khor gcig tu spyad/ /gtong rgyu btags pa khas len 'das pa dang*/ / mtshan nyid pa ni log lta skyes pas gtong*/ /bslab bya nyams pas dman par ltung ba ste/ /bag yod dran pas bsgrims te blang dor bya/ /skyabs gzhan gang gis slu ba de mthong nas/

/lhag par thugs rje'i lha la dad pa nyid/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'jigs bral skyob pa ste/ /de las phan bde byed pa gang zhig yod/ /de na sems gtsang dad pa'i sa gzhi la/ /bsod nams ye shes char chus legs bran te/ /chos khams dge ba'i myu gu cher 'phel bas/ /rgyal ba'i phun tshogs lo thog smin par byed/ /chos tshul dge ba ngo tsha khrel yod shes/ /bag yod dran pa yon tan tshogs mang zhing*/ /gzugs sprin ye shes nyi ma sems la 'char/ /rmi lam na yang mi 'bral mthong ba dang*/ /tshe rabs dran zhing rigs dang 'byor pas mdzes/ /'gro kun dga' bas don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ / mthar yang rang nyid lus can kun gyi skyabs/ /dpung gnyen byed pas sku gsum 'byor pa 'dzin/ /skyabs song yon tan gal te gzugs 'chis na/ /nam mkhas ches lhag bsod nams pha mtha' yas/ /legs pa'i yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /de la mkhas pa su zhig brten mi bgyid/ /nyes spong zhi ba 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen/ /dad brgya'i spyi bos rab tu phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /sa gsum bsod nams 'dren mchog dpag bsam shing*/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /de ltar bde chen yon tan mchog bsgrags pas/ /skye dgu dam pa'i spyod la legs gzhol zhing*/ /nyes gyur dman pa'i yul la brten pa yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// // de ltar skyabs song rten gyi gang zag gis/ /byams pa'i sa gzhir snying rje'i me tog bkram/ /dga' ba'i grib bsil btang snyoms chu gtsang gis/ / 'gro la phan phyir rang gi sems sbyang ngo/ /de yang thar pa'i lam dang ma 'brel na/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi ste srid pa'i rgyu/ /zhi ba'i lam gyis zin pa'i de rnam bzhi/ /srid pa'i chu gter 'da' phyir tshad med bzhi/ / dmigs yul mtha' yas 'gro ba chos nyid la/ /rnam pa kun khyab dmigs bcas dmigs pa med/

/snga ma tshad yod nyung zad 'gro ba la/ /dmigs rnams ma dag dmigs bcas tshangs pa'i rgyu/ /'di ni dmigs med thar par gzhol bas na/ /snying rje'i rang bzhin can gyis bslab par bya/ /bde ba mi ldan sdug bsngl gyis nyam thag /skyid cing 'byor la nye ring chags sdang can/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms yul/ /rnam pa bde thob sdug bsngal bral ba dang*/ /dga' dang mi 'bral sems snyoms las rung 'dod/ /sgom tshul go rims nges ba med na yang*/ /dang po'i gang zag thog mar btang snyoms te/ /nye ring bsnyams nas de nas gzhan gsum sgom/ /de yang dmigs yul sems can thams cad la/ /blo yi rnam pa 'di ltar brtag par bya/ /de ltar pha dang ma dang bshes la chags/ / dgra la sdang ba 'di 'dra'i sems khyod ngan/ /thog mtha' dus med 'khyams tshe dgra 'dis kyang*/ /pha ma la sogs bshes byas phan pa bsgrubs/ /de yi drin lan gnod sems sgom byed dam/ /gnyen 'dis kyang ni dgra byas gnod pa bsgrubs*/ /da lta na yang de yi sdug bsngal 'go /de yi lan du phan pa ji ltar rigs/ /bar ma yang na mdza' dang mi mdzar 'gyur/ /phan gnod ma nges chags sdang rigs pa min/ /de bas thog mar mdza' bshes phyogs rnams la/ / bar ma bzhin du chags pa spang bya zhing*/ /de nas dgra la bar ma bzhin du ni/ / sdang ba spangs la nye ring med par bya/ /bar ma'i phyogs la'ang gti mug dbral ba'i phyir/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs snyam du sel ba'i blo/ /srid dang bral ba de 'dra rnam par bsgom/ /thams cad bde 'dod sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod gcig /'on kyang mi shes sdug bsngal rgyu la spyod/ /kye ma nyam thag 'gro ba'i nyon mongs tshogs/ /bag chags bcas kun zhi la sems snyoms shog / chags sdang drag pos gzir ba'i lus can kun/ /nye ring sems snyoms chags sdang bral bar shog /ces bsam 'gro ba gcig nas gnyis dang gsum/ /yul gru gcig nas gling gcig gling bzhi nas/

/stong gcig gnyis gsum 'jig rten kun la bsgom/ /'byongs pa'i tshad ni bdag gzhan dgra gnyen mnyam/ /rjes la dmigs pa med pa'i btang snyoms yul/ /thams cad sems te sem nyid nam mkha' 'dra/ /don dam ma skyes stong pa'i ngang de la/ /blo yi rnam pa spros dang bral bar gzhag /'byongs pa'i tshad ni zab zhi'i rtogs pa skye/ /'bras bu nye ring rnyog pa med pa'i sems/ /gnas lugs don la rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /de ltar kun la sems snyoms gyur pa na/ /rang nyid ma la bde dang phrad 'dod ltar/ / lus can kun la de bzhin bsam par bya/ /byams pa'i dmigs yul sems can thams cad la/ /rnam pa gnas skabs lha mi'i bde ba dang*/ /mthar thug byang chub bde dang 'phrad par shog /snyam du gcig nas 'gro ba kun gyi bar/ / phyogs mtha' gtugs par de snyed bsgom par bya/ /rtags ni kun la khyab pa'i byams pa mchog /bu gcig brtse ba'i ma bas lhag pa 'byung*/ /de rjes thams cad mnyam pa'i ngang la gzhag /dmigs pa med pa'i byams pa chen po ste/ / byams dang stong pa zung du chud pa rtags/ /'bras bu mthong na yid 'ong dag pa 'thob/ /byams pas 'gro la khyab pa'i rjes nyid du/ /pha ma'i sdug bsngal blos mi bzod pa bzhin/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsams la snying rje bskyed/ /de yang bdag gi pha ma drin can rnams/ /bdag gi ched du sdig pa'i las byas pas/ /tsha grang bkres skom gsad cad las kyis mnar/ /skye rga na 'chi'i chu chen 'khrug par bying*/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs du mas nyam re thag /de las thar 'dod zhi ba'i sems med la/ /yang dag lam ston dge ba'i bshes med pas/ /mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /'di dag mthong nas yal bar 'dor phod dam/ /de bas bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ / dus gsum dge bas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dag /skad cig nyid la bral bar shog cig ces/ /snying khong rus pa'i gting nas bsam par bya/

/'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod rtags su bshad/ /dmigs med snying rjes de rjes mnyam par gzhag /rtags ni stong nyid snying rje zung du 'brel/ /'bras bu gnod sems rnam 'tshe bral ba'i sems/ /las rung gdod nas dag pa nyid du 'grub/ /de ltar snying rjes brlan pa'i 'gro ba la/ /rang rang bde bas gnas te dga' ba bsgom/ /de yang dmigs yul bde ldan sems can te/ / rnam pa e ma 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bdag gis bde la dgod par ma dgos par/ /rang rang bde ba bdag gis rnyed pa rab/ /da ni deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bde zhing skyid pa 'di dang mi 'bral shog /snyam du gcig nas kun la bsgom par bya/ / rtags su phrag dog med cing dga' ba skye/ /de rjes mi dmigs bsam gtan dga' ba nyid/ /lus ngag sems la zhi bde lhun gyis grub/ /'bras bu 'byor pas brtan la dga' ba 'grub/ /de ltar goms rjes byams nas rim par bsgom/ /de yis bzhi po'i zhen pa rim gyis 'gog /byams bsgoms gnyen bzhin kun la chags pa na/ /snying rjes sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras zhan pa 'gog / snying rje dman pas dmigs dang bcas pa na/ /dmigs med dga' bas skyo ba rnam par 'gog /dga' bas sems g.yengs sprod la 'cher ba na/ /nye ring chags bral btang snyoms chen po bsgom/ /btang snyoms bar ma lung ma bstan bzhin na/ /sngar bzhin byams sogs rim pas bsgom par bya/ /de yis 'byongs par sla zhing brtan pa 'thob/ /goms pa shin tu brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rim dang rim min spel ma thod rgal bsgom/ /de yis rtogs pa so mar bogs 'byin zhing*/ /shin tu brtan pas ches brtan nyid du 'gyur/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu bzhi dag las/ /rnam smin mngon mtho nges legs gnyis 'thob la/ /'dod par lha mi'i lus 'grub phan bde byed/ /rgyu mthun byed pas de nyid byed pa dang*/ /myong bas mi mthun phyogs bral bde ba

'thob/ /dbang gis yid 'ong bde zhing rab bdaga'i yul/ /'gro ba mthun cing 'byor pas brgyan par skye/ /byed pas bzhi po ches cher rab 'phel bas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor pa lhun grub 'gyur/ /byams pas zhe sdang med cing longs spyod rdzogs/ /me long ye shes rab tu thob par 'gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni mtshan dpes brgyan/ /snying rjes 'dod chags med cing chos kyi sku/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byed/ /chos kyi sku ni stobs sogs ma 'dres chos/ /dga' bas phrag dog med cing sprul pa'i sku/ /bya grub ye shes dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /sprul pa'i sku ni ma nges sna tshogs gzugs/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i sku ste phrin las yin/ /btang snyoms nga rgyal rmongs med ngo bo nyid/ /mnyam nyid chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byed/ /ngo bo nyid sku chos nyid spros dang bral/ /de ltar byams sogs yon tan mtha' yas shing*/ /mtshungs bral lha mi'i ston pas rab bsngags mdzod/ /de dag mi ldan lam de phyin ci log /ston pa gzhan la skyabs song lam ngan yin/ /des gzung lam ni thar pa dri ma med/ /dus gsum rgyal ba snga phyi'i gshegs shul yin/ /rgyu yi thegs pas sa bon myu gu bzhin/ /thabs shes sku gnyis bskyed par 'dod na yang*/ /'bras bu'i theg pas sku yi sgrib pa gnyis/ /sel byed rkyen gyi rnam pa khas len pas/ /

thabs nyid snying rje tshad med lam la brten/ /don la gcig ste stong nyid snying rje can/ rgyu 'bras gnyis kas mthun par nyams su len/ /gzhan yang thog med dge ba sa bon tshul/ /ma byas ye nas gnas par mdo nas gsungs/ /de dang sku gsum ye ldan glo bur gyi/ /sgrib pas bsgribs te sel 'dod sngags nyid mtshungs/ /mdor na mdor rgyud lam rnams gcig nyid du/ /mkhas grub rnams kyis phyi nang bshad pa mdzad/ /de phyir rgyal sras dam pa'i rjes 'gro zhing*/ /tshad med rnam pa bzhi la 'bad par mdzod/ /de ltar legs gsungs zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro kun sems kyi rnyog pa rab zhi nas/ /lam gol log dang dman par zhugs pa yis/ / dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos shig / rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /tshad med bzhi'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// // de ltar tshad med legs par goms pa yis/ /chos kun rtsa ba byang chub sems gnyis bsgom/ /de yang nyon mongs srid mtsho mthar 'byin zhing*/ / 'jigs dang mya ngan sdig kun sel byed de/ /las dang sdug bsngal 'du byed rnam par 'joms/ /srid nas zhi bar 'gro ba 'dren byed yin/ /gang la sems pa mngon gyur med na yang*/ /snying rje'i dge rgyun gong nas gong 'phel zhing*/ / mnyam gzhag na yang thabs shes zung du 'brel/ /lus ngag rtsom pa thams cad don yod cing*/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi mchod sdong 'gyur/ /dge gzhan 'bras bu dman te zad pa ltar/ /rin chen sems zin dge ba mi zad 'phel/ / ji ltar rgya mtsho dngas pa'i chu 'bab dang*/ /sa gzhi bzang por lo thog phun tshogs bzhin/ /kun gyi rtsa ba sa bon snying rje'i bdag /srid pa na yang bde ba'i 'bras mang zhing*/ /zhi ba'i rang bzhin byang chub mchog gi rgyu/ /rin chen sems legs bskyed la 'bad par mdzod/ /de ni dpal rgyas yid bzhin bum pa bzang*/ /'gro ba'i nad gso bde 'byung sman gyi mchog

/ye shes nyi ma gdung sel zla ba ste/ /mkha' bzhin dri med yon tan rgyu skar tshogs/ /rtag tu phan bde byed pa'i rang bzhin la/ /bsam yas bsod nams sprin tshogs dpag tu med/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan shin tu rmad byung dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings ltar dpag yas rgya che 'o/ /sems bskyed pa ni tshad med 'gro ba'i phyir/ /yang dag sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa ste/ /smon dang 'jug pa'i rang bzhin gnyis yin no/ / de yang bsam pas smon dang sbyor bas khyab/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba nyid bzhin no/ /smos pa tshad med bzhi yi ngo bo la/ /'jug pa pha rol phyin pa drug tu 'dod/ /gang gis phyogs mtha' gtugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por bsnyen bkur te/ /rang nyid legs pa tsam zhig don gnyer ba'i/ / bsod nams de yis smon pa'i char mi phod/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal nyung zad sel ba'i blo/ / skad cig skyes pas ngan song thar gyur cing*/ /lha mi'i bde ba dpag med myong bar gsungs/ /de bas 'jug pa'i phan yon mtha' yas te/ / dngos su sbyor bas yang dag khyab pa'i phyir/ /skad cig sbyor bas khyab pa'i sems mchog gis/ /bskal pa mang po'i tshogs gnyis bzlums par bshad/ / de phyir grangs med gsum sogs gsungs pa kun/ /myur du rdzogs dang ring du rdzogs pa dang*/ /tshe gcig grol ba blo yi stobs la rag /de yang thabs dang brtson 'grus shes rab mchog /gsum gyis bsgrub gang bla med stobs che 'o/ /'di ni snying rje'i ljon shing snying po can/ /'gro ba'i khur chen legs par khyer ba ni/ /tshangs sogs 'jig rten na yang sngon med cing*/ /rang nyid phyir yang rmi lam ma smis na/ /gzhan phyir smos ci 'tshal ba'i byang chub sems/ /snga na med pa 'khrungs la dga' ba bskyed/ /de yang dge ba'i bshes las 'byung ba ste/ /yid bzhin dag las 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs bzhin/ /skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma yis/

/skal bzang slob ma spro ba bskyed pa ni/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thar pa'i phan yon sogs/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge'i chos rnams dang*/ /byang chub sems kyi bsngags pa mtha' yas brjod/ /gnas gtsang mchod pas mdzes shing nyams dga' bar/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs la sogs sta gon bya/ /nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rgya mtsho'i sprin phung bsam/ /'di ni rang gi sems stobs dri med dang*/ / mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rnam kyi thugs rje yis/ /ji ltar bsams pa de bzhin 'grub par gsungs/ /de nas thal sbyar me tog snyim bkang nas/ /spyan drang bzhugs gsol khrus rgyan gos sogs dbul/ /yid 'ong rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa yi/ /'char ka'i padma kha 'bus bye 'dra ba/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar bstod dbyangs bcas/ / lus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /sa 'di rir bcas rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed du/ /bsod nams de 'dra 'jig rten gsum na med/ /lus btud dbang chen bar gyi rdul rnams dang*/ / mnyam pa'i grangs snyed 'khor los sgyur 'gro zhing*/ /mthar thug zhi ba mchog gi go 'phang 'thob/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /mchod pa bla med rgya chen rnams kyis mchod/ /me tog spos dang mar me zhal zas chu/ /bla re 'phan ldang gdugs dang rol mo'i sgra/ /rgyal mtshan rnga yab rdza rnga la sogs dang*/ /lus dang longs spyod mkho dgu'i yo byad kyis/ /'gro ba'i bla ma dkon mchog sras bcas mchod/ /lha sogs 'jig rten kun na yid 'ong ba'i/ / gzhal med khang brtsegs rin chen dra ba can/ /glu gar sil snyan bstod dbyangs char 'bab cing*/ /rgyan mchog brgya phrag mnga' ba rnams kyis mchod/ /rin chen ri bo nags tshal padma'i mtsho/ /ngang mo'i 'gros kyis gnyer ba de dag dang*/ / sman sogs dri zhim ngad ldang dpag bsam shing*/ /me tog 'bras bu dud pa'i tshogs kyis mchod/

/'dab stong g.yo bas bung ba bzung ba yi/ /lag pa'i gdu bu ku mu tas mtshan zhing*/ /sprin bral nyi zla'i zer gyis rab phye ba'i/ / utpa la sogs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod/ /tsandan bsil ba'i kha yi sbubs bskyod pa'i/ /dri zhim ser bu bde ba'i ngad rnams dang*/ /phug dang brag ri sman ljongs nyams dga' ba/ /chu bsil rdzing bu gang ba rnams kyis mchod/ / ston ka'i mtshan mo dkar ba'i ri bong 'dzin/ /gza' bral rgyu skar phreng bas bskor ba dang*/ /nyin byed 'od stong dra bas mdzes 'bar ba/ /gling bzhi'i 'jig rten rgyan gyur rnams kyis mchod/ /khor yug rir bcas bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing*/ /ma lus yongs bkod 'dod dgus 'byor pa dang*/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kun/ /blo yis blangs te thub dbang sras bcas mchod/ /bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang*/ /nye ba'i rin chen bdun sogs rgya che bas/ /yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams mchod/ /ting 'dzin yid kyis nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /me tog sprin 'dzes lding khang mdzes 'bar ba/ /spos dang sman spyar bdud rtsi'i sprin phung dang*/ / gzi ldan sgron ma zhal zas rol mo'i sprin/ /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis mchod/ /'jug pa'i sprin can shin tu mtha' yas pa/ /sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chain glu gar sogs/ /mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs sprin 'phro bas/ / rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus gnyes gyur cig /thog med dus nas goms pa'i bag chags kyis/ /las dang nyon mongs sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /srid pa'i rgyur gyur de kun bshags par bgyi/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams phung po mtha' yas la/ /rtag par bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /ma lus skye dgu'i tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor bar bskul/

/deng nas srid pa'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs par gsol/ / dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /ma lus phyam gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ji ltar khrus kyis sbyangs pa'i ras yug dag /tshon gyis bsgyur bas kha dog gsal ba bzhin/ /de ltar sngon du 'gro bas sems sbyangs pa'i/ /rgyud las dngos gzhi'i sems mchog gsal bar skye/ /'di ni bsod nams 'bras bu tshad med de/ /chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab/ /de nas sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /lan gsum bar du skyabs su 'gro byas te/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyis/ /byang chub thugs bskyed bslab la gnas pa ltar/ / deng nas bdag gis 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems bskyed bslab la gnas par bgyi/ /ma brgal ba rnams bdag gis bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol bgyi zhing*/ /dbugs ma phyung rnams bdag gis dbugs dbyung ste/ /sems can rnams ni mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /de ltar nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /byang chub sems gnyis bskyed la 'bad par bya/ /brjod pa dang pos smon pa sems bskyed la/ /gnyis pas 'jug pa sems bskyed gsum pa yis/ /gnyis ka brtan zhing dag pa thob par 'gyur/ /deng nas bdag ni 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang thob/ /srid na mi 'jigs 'gro ba'i don byed cing*/ /rtag tu phan pa 'ba' zhig lhur len pas/ /mi yi srid pa don dang bcas bar gyur/ /da ni sems gtsang dge ba'i sa gzhi la/ /byang chub sems gnyis myu gu rab bskyed de/ /de gzung dag pa spel phyir brtson par bya/ /'gro pa'i sdug bsngal bdag gis blang bya zhing*/ /bdag gi bde bas 'gro ba bder gyur te/ /byang chub bar du de dang mi 'bral shog /snyam du gtong len spel mar sbyang bya zhing*/

/smon pa'i bslab bya tshad med bzhi po bsgom/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs spang sems bsrung bya/ /'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol phyin drug spyad/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs spang brtson par bya/ /rtag tu dran dang shes bzhin bag yod kyis/ /mi dge spang zhing dge chos rgya mtsho bsgrub/ /byang chub sems gnyis mi nyams bslab bya ste/ / log par lta sogs rgyal po'i ltung ba lnga/ /grong sogs blon po'i lnga dang phal pa'i brgyad/ /thun mong gnyis te nyi shu ltung byed la/ /de dang phyogs mthun nyes byas shes par bya/ /de dag mi ldan ltung dang nyes med de/ /dge ba'i phyogs mthun bslab byar shes par bya/ /mdor na nag po'i chos bzhi spang bya zhing*/ / dkar po'i chos bzhi dag la nan tan bya/ /mchod 'os slu dang 'gyod pa med la bskyed/ /dam pa rnams la mi snyan sgrogs pa dang*/ /'gro ba'i nang na g.yo dang sgyus spyod pa/ /nag po'i chos bzhi lags pas spang 'tshal lo/ /dam pa bsten zhing yon tan bsngags pa brjod/ /sems can rnams ni yang dag dge la bskul/ /rgyal sras rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas 'gro la phan bde byed/ /dkar po'i chos rab bzhi po bsten par mdzod/ /rang don las kyang gzhan phan gtsor 'dzin pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa ste/ /gzhan don 'gyur na lus ngag mi dge bdun/ /gnang ba'i skabs yod don la dge ba yin/ /yid gsum nam yang gnang ba'i skabs med do/ /rang don zhi bde 'dod pa'i dge ba yang*/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i ltung ba ste/ /gzhan phyir phan na mi dge gang lags pa/ /de yang bslab bya lags par rgyal bas gsungs/ /rgyal sras de yang rnam pa gsum nyid de/ /rang nyid grol nas 'gro ba sgrol 'dod pa/ /rgyal po lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang dang 'gro ba mnyam du thar 'dod pa/ /gru pa lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /'gro ba bsgral nas rang nyid zhi 'dod pa/

/rdzi bo lta bu'i byang chub senas dpa' gsum/ /rim bzhin grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ /bdun dang gsum gyis grol ba thob pa ni/ /dbang po'i rim pa lags par mdo las gsungs/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis kun la bslab pa ste/ /gtso bor pha rol phyin pa drug la bslab/ /'gro ba dbul bas nyam thag mthong nas ni/ /zas gos rta dang shing rta glang po sogs/ /mkho dgu'i yo byad dpag med gtong ba ste/ /bu dang bu mo la sogs gtong ba che/ /mgo dang mig sogs shin tu gtong ba ste/ /zang zing dang ni chos kyis phan pa bsgrub/ /des ni rang gi ser sna'i tshogs 'joms shing*/ /gzhan gyi 'byor pa nye bar skye bar 'gyur/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyis ni rgyud bsdams shing*/ /sems kyis dge ba zhi ba rnam bsgrubs la/ /shes rab kyis ni don gnyis phun tshogs 'thob/ /sdom dang chos sdud sems can don byed de/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis tshul khrims gsum rtag bsrung*/ khyim pas dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas smon 'jug la/ /rab tu byung bas dge slong dge tshul dang*/ / dge slob ma yi sdom pa gang yin steng*/ /byang chub sems gnyis bsrung ba tshul khrims yin/ /phyi nang gnod pa sna tshogs sdug bsngal la/ /ji mi snyam dang snying rjes chos la som/ /dmigs med bzod pa gsum yang bsgrub par bya/ /zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa 'ga' med la/ /bzod mtshungs dka' thub bsod nams gzhan med pas/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis bzod la nan tan du/ / khro ba'i me chen 'jil la brtson par bya/ /gnod pa'i yul rnams mi bsrun grangs med pas/ /re re zhing yang gdul bar yod mi long*/ /sems gcig btul bas thams cad dul 'gyur ba/ /sems 'dul brtul zhugs bsrung la nan tan mdzod/ /gnod la brten nas bzod pa'i legs pa 'grub/ snying rje dang ni byams sems yon tan skye/ /byang chub grogs gyur dgra la ston pa bzhin/ /gus dang spro bas bzod pa nye bar bsten/
