/gzhan yang bdag nyid med na mi 'byung la/ /brag ca bzhin du phan tshun brten pa can/ /rang gis nyais gyur gnod pa'i tshogs rab 'di/ /'phral gyi rkyen dang sngon las rgyus bskyed phyir/ /'di 'byung rigs te las zad thabs 'di la/ /ci nas sems 'dul gcig pu bsran tshugs bya/ /mi 'dod thog tu bab la mi dga' btang*/ /bcos su yon na mi dgar ci dgos la/ /med na phan pa med pas ci byar yod/ /de bas rkyen rnams bzod la nan tan bya/ /brtags na mkha' bzhin stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ /dga' dang mi dga' shor god legs nyes med/ /de la gnyis su bzung yang don med kyis/ /thams cad mnyam nyid ngang la nan tan mdzod/ / gang la brtson pa'i rang bzhin dge la spro/ /de la dge chos mi zad sprin bzhin 'du/ /dri zhim padma'i tshal du bung ba bzhin/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs gang le lo gsum/ /bya ba ngan zhen sgyid lug bdag nyid brnyas/ /legs pa mi 'grub nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /phun tshogs nyams la rgud pa skye bar 'gyur/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa 'jig rten gyis bstod cing*/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa mi yi bsam pa 'grub/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa yon tan tshogs 'phel zhing*/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /de yang 'jig rten dge chos mchog rnams dang*/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lam ni gang yin pa/ zag bcas zag pa med pa'i chos rnams la/ /mi dge spang zhing dge ba bsgrubs pa'i phyir/ /'bad rtsol brtson pas yang dag gnas par bya/ /ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar du ni/ /

ches cher gong du yang dag 'gror yod pas/ /de srid mi ngal 'bad pas brtson 'grub brtsam/ /bsam gtan 'dod pas rnams g.yeng 'du 'dzi spang*/ /yul gyi dga' ba ston ka'i sprin 'dra zhing*/ /glog ltar mi brtan g.yo ba'i rang bzhin te/ /longs spyod mi rtag sgyu ma'i khang bzang 'dra/ /nam yang yid brtan mi rung de spangs te/ /myur ba nyid du zhi ba'i nags 'dab bsten/ /'dod pa rnams ni phung krol bskyed pa ste/ /bsag dang bsrung dang tshol bas sdug bsngal zhing*/ / khengs dang sred dang 'jugs pas ser sna 'phel/ /ngan 'gror 'khrid cing bde 'gro'i lam 'gog pas/ /'dod pa chung dang chog shes ldan par bya/ /lus rma ji snyed sdug bsngal khyab pa ltar/ /nor mang ji snyed sdug bsngal de bas mang*/ /yo byad bsnyungs rnams bde ba mtha' yas te/ /'tshe ba nyung zhing dgra rkun 'jigs pa med/ /kun gyis bstod cing 'phags pa'i lam la gnas/ /bya ba nyung zhing sems las chung bas na/ /rtag tu 'dod pa chung la bslab par bya/ /byis dang 'grogs pa'i nyes pa tshad med de/ /sdig pa 'phel zhing mi dge ngang gis 'go / dge ba 'grib cing rtsod dang nyon mongs skye/ /byas pa mi gzon ma yang mgu bar dka'/ /don med bya ba mang zhing 'du 'dzis g.yeng*/ /me dang sbrul dang gcan gzan khrod 'dra ba'i/ /byis pa rnams las thag ring 'byol bar bya/ /ji srid sems la brtan pa ma thob bar/ /phyi rol yul gyis rab tu slu bas na/ /dben pa'i nags su spro bas gnas par bya/ /ji srid skyes bu bzhi yis btegs pa'i lus/ /ngud mo'i sgra dang bcas par ma gyur bar/ /bdag ni zhi ba'i dgon par rab phyogs te/ /lus sems 'du 'dzi'i dgra las rgyal bar bya/ /nags ni chu gtsang me tog 'bras mang zhing*/ /brag ri'i phug dang rdo leb khang bzangs mang*/ /dud pa'i ljon shing grib mas brgyan pa'i khrod/ /bya dang ri dgas mang po gar byed cing*/ /chu 'gram me tog bung ba glu len mdzes/

/spos dang sman sogs dri zhim ngad ldang zhing*/ /dben zhing nyams dga' bsam gtan ngang gis 'phel/ /dus bzhir dga' bas padma'i mtsho 'dra zhing*/ /so ga dbyar dang ston dus dgun dang dpyid/ /rim gyis 'gyur bas mi rtag skyo shas 'phel/ /dur khrod rus pa 'thor ba'i tshul mthong nas/ /bdag gi lus kyang de 'dra'i ngang tshul can/ /so sor 'gyes chos can du mthong bar 'gyur/ /'dus byas snying po med pa'i 'khor ba la/ /dga' ba'i blo gros gang yin ring du byed/ /rtsod dang nyon mongs med cing rtag zhi bas/ /rang gi sems ni las rung bde ba 'thob/ /de 'dra'i nags ni rgyal ba rnams kyis bsngags/ /srid la skyo bas dgon par rab phyogs te/ /gom pa bdun tsam bor ba'i bsod nams ni/ /gang gis bskal pa gadgā'i sangs rgyas la/ /bskal par mchod pa'i bsod nams phung po yis/ /snga ma'i bsod nams brgya stong char mi phod/ /de phyir zhi ba'i nags 'dab bsten par bya/ /der ni stan la skyil krung rab bcas nas/ /rtse gcig sems la mi g.yo mnyam par gzhag /byis pa nyer spyod don rab 'byed pa dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan dam pa bsgrub/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang de bzhin gzugs med bzhi/ /lam la zhugs dang zhugs zin 'phags rnams kyis/ / ting 'dzen gsum gyi ming rnams shes par bya/ /des ni 'dod yon dga' ba'i sems spong zhing*/ /rig dang mngon shes ting 'dzin mngon par 'grub/ /spyan dang rdzu 'phrul sems la rang dbang bsgyur/ /shes rab gsum ste thos bsam sgom pa nyid/ /lhag mthong grub pas nyon mongs tshogs spong zhing*/ /chos dang chos can gnas lugs rab shes nas/ /srid pa'i grong las mya ngan 'das zhir 'gro/ /snang 'di gdod nas ma skyes gzugs brnyan bzhin*/ /ngo bo med la sna tshogs snang ba ste/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i rten 'brel mthong nas ni/ /mi gnas mchog gi go 'phang myur du reg /shes rab ldan pa thabs kyis grol 'gyur

te/ /ji ltar dug la sngags kyis btag pa bzhin*/ /shes rab med na thabs kyis 'ching 'gyur te/ /sman nyid nad du song bas gdung ba bzhin/ /de phyir gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyed/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la spyod pa na/ /sgyu ma'i skye bo ji bzhin shes par bya/ /'khor gsum mi rtogs dge ba'i tshogs gnyis kyis/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang zhi ba thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar dge legs sprin gyi bzhon pa yis/ /'gro sems gtsang ma'i lo thog legs bskrun te/ /srid pa'i nyes tshogs dbul bas rab phongs pa'i/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig / rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// // de ltar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /gsang sngags phyi nang bskyed rdzogs don la 'jug /de yang thabs mang dka' ba med phyir dang*/ / don gcig na yang 'jug tshul ma rmongs dang*/ /dbang po shin tu rnon po'i dbang mdzad de/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor bla na med bzhi bstan/ /dus dang mi rigs dbang po'i rim pa ste/ /rdzogs ldan gsum ldan nyis ldan rtsod ldan dang*/ /bram ze rje'u rigs rgyal rigs gdol pa'am dmangs/ /rtul po 'bring rnon shin tu rnon po la/ /khrus dang gtsang sbra gtsor ston bya ba'i rgyud/ /lus ngag bya dang sems kyi sgom pa kun/ /cha mnyam ston pa spyod pa'i rgyud sde dang*/ /sgom pa gtsor ston lus ngag spyod pa kun/ /grogs tsam ston pa rnal 'byor rgyud dang ni/ /sgo gsum bya bral gzung 'dzin mi dmigs par/ / sems kyi chos nyid 'od gsal brtul zhugs mchog/ /gtsang sgra chung rnams dor ni rnal 'byor che/ /de yang bya spyod rnal 'byor thub pa rgyud/ /krī ya u pa yo ga zhes bya 'o/ /de dag gsang sngags phyi ste lha rnams kyang*/ /yab yum zung 'brel bsgom par mi nus shing*/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs ston mi byed/

/gtsang sbra kun du spyod pas gnas pa yin/ /rnal 'byor bla med rgyud la'ang gsum yin te/ /pha ma gnyis su med pa bla na med/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis med gtso bor ston pa ste/ /ma hā a nu a ti zhes bya 'o/ /lha yang 'khril sbyor dam rdzas khyad par can/ /gtsang btsog gnyis med thams cad ro gcig tu/ /dkyil 'khor gcig gi rol par ston pa yin/ /bya bas rang nyid dman la lha nyid mchog /rje khol tshul du bsgrub pas dngos grub len/ /spyod pas rang dang lha nyid mnyam par blta/ /rang nyid dam tshig mdun du ye shes lha/ / grogs po'i tshul gyis dngos grub len pa yin/ / rnal 'byor dngos gzhir gnyis su med pa la/ /sbyor rjes lha ni dgug gshegs gnyis su byed/ /chu la chu bzhag gnyis med dngos grub len/ /ma hās rlung dang bskyed rim thabs gtso la/ /a nus khams dang rdzogs rim shes rab gtso/ / a tis thams cad gnyis med ye shes gtso/ /kun kyang chos kun ye shes mnyam pa nyid/ /yin pa shes pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len/ /bdag dang 'gro kun ye nas sangs rgyas pas/ /phung po khams dang skya mched la sogs kun/ / dkyil 'khor gcig tu gsal btab rim gnyis bsgom/ /de yang skye bzhi'i rim pas sgo mtshul bzhi/ /sgong skyes bag chags sbyang phyir sngon 'gro'i tshe/ / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bskyed rim mdor bsdus nas/ /bsod nams zhing rab spyan drangs mchod pa'i mthar/ /rang bzhin med bsgom tshogs gnyis sngon song nas/ /gdod kyis bskyed rdzogs rgyas par bsgom pa ni/ /thog mar sgo nga de las bya skye bzhin/ /mdor bsdus rgyas pa'i bskyed rdzogs rim pas bsgom/ / mngal skyes bag chags sbyang phyir bstan pa ni/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong las sa bon dang/ /phyag mtshan las ni sku dang 'od zer sogs/ /rim gyis rgyas par bsgom gyis sngar bzhin du/ /mdor bsdus sngon du mi 'gro'i bskyed rdzogs ni/

/ji ltar rlung sems thig le dkar dmar las/ / mer nur ltar dang mkhrang gyur la sogs nas/ /lus yongs rdzogs te btsa' ba'i bar bzhin no/ /drod gsher las skyes bag chags sbyang bya'i phyir/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong las lha rnams kyi/ /mtshan tsam brjod las lhar gsar bskyed rdzogs bsgom/ /ji ltar drod gsher 'dus pas grub ba'i lus/ /shin tu 'grub par sla bas btsa' ba bzhin/ /sa bon phyag mtshan spros pa dgos pa med/ / brdzus te skye ba'i bag chags sbyang bya'i phyir/ /skad cig tsam gyis wal gyis bskyed rdzogs bsgom/ /ji ltar rdzus skyes skad cig snang ba bzhin/ /ming las rim gyis bskyed rdzogs bsgom mi dgos/ /de ltar sgom tshul rnam pa bzhi nyid kyang*/ /gtso bor skye ba gang bsdus des bsgoms la/ /bag chags sbyang phyir kun gyis de bzhin bsgom/ khyad par las dang po yis sgong skyes bzhin/ /cung zad brtan pas mngal bskyed bzhin bsgoms la/ /brtan pa che bas drod gsher skyes bzhin bsgom/ /shin tu goms pa yang dag brtan pa yis/ /rdzus skyes bzhin du skad cig dkrong bskyed bya/ /rdzogs rim de yang snang bcas snang med de/ /bskyed rim bsdus nas mkha' la sprin dngas bzhin/ /mi dmigs ngang du 'jog pa snang ba med/ /bskyed rim de nyid rdzogs par shes bya ste/ /snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /ma yengs bsgom pa snang bcas rim pa bzhin/ /las dang po yis bskyed rim zhen pa dgag /snang la bden par zhen pa'i gnyen po byed/ /brtan pa rnams kyis rdzogs rim zhen pa dgag /stong la mtshan mar zhen pa'i gnyen po byed/ /phyi nas gang snang bskyed rim thabs nyid la/ /'dzin med shes pa rdzogs rim shes rab nyid/ /dus rnams kun tu 'du 'bral med par 'chang*/ /bskyed rim snang 'di'i bden zhen 'gog pa ste/ / rdzogs rim sgyu mar zhen pa'i rtog pa spong*/

/gang la snang stong bden zhen med pa na/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis med rang bzhin dag pa yin/ /'di ni mthar thug rdo rje'i theg pa ste/ /dbang po rnon po tshe 'dir rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de rjes gdul bya'i 'jig rten gang yod der/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa sna tshogs lhun gyis grub/ /'di ni grangs med rdo rje 'chang rnams kyi/ /nye lam sbas pa shin tu zab mo ste/ /skal bzang tshe 'dir grol 'dod rnams kyis bsten/ /de yang gang mos rgyud sde'i rim pa la/ /brten nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /thog mar rig gtad rjes gnang dbang la sogs/ /rang rang gzhung nas gsungs pa'i lung mnos te/ /rang gi sems 'di yongs su smin par bya/ /khyad par mchog gsang rnal 'byor chen po'i lam/ /smin byed dbang bzhi grol byed bskyed rdzogs te/ /bum dbang lus dang gsang bas ngag dang ni/ /shes rab ye shes yid dang tshig dbang gis/ bag chags mtha' dag sbyong zhing dngos grub ster/ /dang po gsum gyis bsod nams tshogs rdzogs la/ /bzhi pas ye shes tshogs rdzogs de bzhin du/ /nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrig kun sbyong*/ /de phyir smin byed dbang bzhi thob pa yis/ /grol byed bskyed rdzogs don la bslab par bya/ /'dir ni dbang rdzogs dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /gnyis med a ti'i dgongs par 'jug 'dod pas/ /bde ba'i stan la skyil krung rab bcas nas/ /skyabs su 'gro dang byang chub sems bskyed de/ /chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ /rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i ngang nyid las/ /hūm̐ las steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba/ /rtsibs bcu khro bo bcu yis mtshan pa ste/ /phyi nang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na dpal/ /kun du bzang po'i dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ /sgo bzhi grub bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan cing*/ /rtseg pa lnga dang 'dod yon snam bu

dang*/ /pha gu dra phyed mda' yab pu shus mdzes/ /phyur bu'i thod pa rin chen rdo rje'i tog /dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /seng ge glang chen rta dang rma bya dang*/ /shang shang padma nyi zlas spras pa'i steng*/ /rigs lnga so so'i yul dang sems dpa' brgyad/ /sems ma brgyad dang sgo ba yab yum brgyad/ /thub pa drug rnams so so'i gnas bzhugs te/ /sku mdog phyag 'tshan rgyan rnams rdzogs pa las/ /mu med 'od zer phyogs mtha' gtugs par 'phro/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar gzhi yi kun tu bzang*/ /yab yum 'khril sbyor mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /mkha' ltar dri med mthon mthing skyil krung tshul/ /tshon gang 'od kyi gong bu 'bar bar bsgom/ /de las 'od 'phros snang srid snod bcud sbyangs/ /thams cad rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i ngang*/ /yi ge gsum dang rigs lnga'i sa bon bzlas/ /grag stong skye med brag ca ji bzhin no/ /de nyid ngang la ma bcos mnyam par gzhag /rang sems ye nas lha yi rang bzhin la/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor sgra tshig gsang sngags nyid/ /thams cad lhun rdzogs ye shes chen po'i ngang*/ /dam tshig ye shes gnyis med dgug gzhug med/ /gshegs gsol mi dgos bzang ngan blang dor med/ /ye nas dkyil 'khor yin pa'i bdag nyid la/ /yin par shes pa'i tshul gyis gsal 'debs las/ /ma grub pa la yang grub byed pa min/ /rjes la zhen pa yod na rim gyis bsdu/ /gang du'ang mi dmigs spros dang bral bar gzhag /med na sgyu ma chu zla'i ngang nyid nas/ /dge ba sems can don du bsngo bar bya/ /spyod lam kun tu stong gsal sgyu ma'i tshul/ /snang dang grag pa thams cad lha dang sngags/ /dran dang sems pa thams cad ye shes su/ / skad cig skad cig ma yengs shes par bya/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig gtsang ma bsrung*/ /shes dang mi spang spyad dang dang du blang*/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshigs lnga lnga ste/

nyi shu rtsa lnga mdor bsdus sku gsung thugs/ /de yang rang sems rnam dag tshul la bslab/ /nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad nyi shu dgu/ /tshes bcu yar ngo mar ngo'i nyin dang mtshan/ /bsnyed sgrub tshogs mchod bskang bshags 'bad par bya/ /rlung sems rtsa dang thig le'i rnal 'byor sogs/ / yang zab gnad la nan tan snying por bya/ /bde gsal mi rtog zung 'jug lam bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa tshe 'dir rdzogs sangs rgya/ /de ltar rab gsang bla med snying po 'dis/ /he ru ka dpal grong du nyer 'tsho zhing*/ / 'gro kun las dang nyon mongs srid pa 'dir/ /dub pa'i sems nyid di ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyis ngal gso las/ /bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// // de ltar bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel rnal 'byor pas/ /chos rnams ma skyes stong pa'i tshul la 'jug /de yang snang sring 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ / ye nas bdag med spros dang bral ba la/ /ma rig 'dzin pas srid pa 'dir 'khyams te/ /'khor 'das bde sdug sna tshogs snang mod kyang*/ /snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang*/ /sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra bar mkhyen par mdzod/ / 'di ltar phyi rol snang ba'i dngos po kun/ /sems la snang yang sems su grub pa med/ /sems las gzhan du'ang grub pa 'ga' med de/ /bag chags dbang gis gzung 'dzin gnyis spang yang*/ /snang dus nyid nas gzung 'dzin gnyis med pa/ /bzhin dang me long nang gi gzugs bzhin no/ /der ni byad nyid snang yang ma grub pa/ /byad las gzhan gyi rnam pa gtod byed med/ /med bzhin gnyis su snang ba mngon sum ltar/ /sna tshogs chos rnams de bzhin shes par

bya/ /ma brtags nyams dga' brtags na ngos gzung med*/ /shin tu brtags na smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /yod med mi dmigs mtha' bral ma bral med/ /sgyu ma'i tshul du skye sogs snang na yang*/ /snang dus nyid nas skye sogs rang bzhin med/ /smig sgyu'i chu dang rdzing bu'i zla gzugs bzhin/ /khyad par ma dag 'gro drug snang ba 'di/ /med bzhin snang ba bag chags 'khrul pa'i gzugs/ /rab rib can la skra shad snang ba bzhin/ /de bsal 'dod pas bad kan sbyong ba ltar/ /'khrul snang dag 'dod ma rig ling tog bsal/ /de yi gnyen por rig pa'i ye shes kyis/ /'khor ba'i bag chags stong par la bzla zhing*/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin snang bar thag bcad de/ /snang stong gnyis med bden pa gnyis don shes/ /mtha' gnyis gnas bsal dbu mar bslabs pa yis/ /srid zhir mi gnas nam mkha'i ngang du grol/ /'di ni nges don snying po'i dam pa ste/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs yin/ /snang ba'i dngos kyis phan gnod gnyis su med/ /der 'dzin zhen pas srid par 'ching bas na/ /sna tshogs snang la brtag dpyad mi dgos kyi/ /'dzin pa'i sems kyi rtsa ba bcad par mdzod/ /sems ni snang la rang bzhin 'ga' med de/ /btsal bas mi rnyed bltas pas mthong ba med/ /kha dog dbyibs med ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /phyi dang nang med dus gsum skye 'gag med/ /phyogs dang ris med gzhi rtsa dngos po med/ /'di zhes mi mtshon bsam yul 'das pa'i sems/ / 'gags pa mi dmigs ma skyes phyogs na med/ /da ltar mi gnas rang bzhin mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /sems kyis sems ma tshol bar dal du chug /dgag sgrub dran rig skad cig yid kyi yul/ /snang tsam nyid nas phyi dang nang na'ang med/ /btsal bya'i don gyis tshol mkhan byas pas bslad/ /rang gis rang btsal nam yang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /ye nas skye med rang bzhin gnyug ma'i don/ /mi gnas 'gags pa med pa'i sems nyid ni/

/dus gsum gzhi rtsa med pas stong pa'i ngang*/ /sna tshogs 'char gzhi ma 'gags snang ba la/ /dngos po mtshan ma med pas rtag pa med/ /rang shar 'gag pa med pas chad pa med/ / gnyis dang gnyis med med pas brjod du med/ /'di zhes grub pa med pas ngos gzung med/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag par shes par bya/ /brtags pas med ltar ma brtags dus na'ang med/ /rang bzhin gnyis med gdod ma'i ngo bo la/ /bzang ngan blang dor re dogs mi dmigs pas/ /brtag dang dpyad pas 'di la ci byar yod/ /dus gsum yid kyis tshol khro ma byed zhog /rtog ge spros pa'i sbun pas bskyod pa'i sems/ /rnam g.yeng rlung ltar g.yo bas mi rtogs kyi/ /bsal gzhag 'gro 'ong med pa'i byang chub sems/ /kun byed ye shes dri med ngo bo nyid/ /ji bzhin bzhag pas de bzhin mthong ba yin/ /'dir ni sna tshogs grub mtha' mang po dang*/ /bsam brjod rtog pa du mas ci zhig bya/ /nges pa'i don la grub dang ma grub med/ /mtha' dang dbus med theg pa'i rnam dbye med/ /mkha' bzhin rnam dag rgya chad phyogs lhung med/ /de la yod med blos brtags 'khrul pas na/ /brjod du med gang ji ltar bshad du yod/ /don med gnas la rab tu ngal bar zad/ /ji ltar mkha' dbus dngas ba'i skyed mos tshal/ /me tog 'bras mang 'bab chus brgyan pa zhig /mngon du bsams nas de yi rnam dbye dang*/ /mthun phyogs mi mthun phyogs gang rtsod pa bzhin/ /gang yang dri med sems nyid dag pa la/ /bcos bsgyur dri mas nam yang mthong ba med/ /de la bskyed dang rdzogs pas ci zhig bya/ /dang ba'i bsam gtan bsgoms pas bslad par zad/ /gdod nas rang bzhin dag pa'i sems nyid la/ /spang gnyen bral thob med kyis dmigs gtad shol/ /phyi nang gzung 'dzin med kyis ched 'dzin thong*/ /'di zhes ngos gzung med kyis zhen pa chod/ /thog dang ma thob med kyis re dogs spongs/ /gzhi nas 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rig pa la/

/sna tshogs rkyen gyi rnam pa ci shar yang*/ /shar ba de nyid rang gi thog tu grol/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin chos skur phyam gcig go /gang du bltas tshe blta mkhan ngo bo stong/ /btsal bas ma rnyed yul dang phyogs na med/ /'tshol mkhan nyid kyang mi dmigs spros dang bral/ /byed po mi gnas bya ba'i yul gyis stong*/ /mkha' bzhin dri med gdod ma'i ngang du phyin/ /ldog pa'i gnas med da ni gang du 'gro/ /zad par thug ste 'ong ba 'ga' yang med/ /sus kyang mi mthong kho bo gang na 'dug /de nyid shes na gzhan zhig dgos mi 'gyur/ /grol ba rnams ni nga bzhin 'khrul pa chad/ /da ni mi 'dri sems kyi gzhi rtsa stor/ /gtad med 'dzin med nges med 'di yin med/ /phyal ba lhug pa yengs pa phyam gcig pa/ /'di ltar rtogs nas da ni glu len te/ /drimed 'od zer shar bas bstan nas song*/ /kye ho grogs dag snang ba'i yul la ltos/ / thams cad ma skyes stong par mnyam pa nyid/ /me long gzugs brnyan sna tshogs ci shar yang*/ /me long ngos yin dngas par gcig pa bzhin/ /de nyid 'byed pa'i yid la tshur ltos dang*/ /sems ni mkha' 'dra dgag sgrub kun dang bral/ /mkha' la sprin rnams byung nas zhig na yang*/ /nam mkha'i cho 'phrul gnyis med dag pa bzhin/ /rang bzhin dri med gdod ma'i sangs rgyas te/ /ma byas lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid do/ /yul sems gnyis med ye nas dag pa la/ /spang blang gnyis med phyogs ris dgag sgrub med/ /gang snang bden med gang shar stong pa nyid/ /thams cad mnyam nyid gza' gtad kun dang bral/ /yul la nges med snang ba sna tshogs ltar/ /blo la gtad med phyogs bral chen po nyid/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen por shes par bya/ /'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams la/ /'das pa'i chos rnams mi dmigs mnyam pa nyid/ /ma 'ongs chos rnams ma skyes mnyam pa nyid/ /da lta'i chos rnams mi gnas mnyam pa nyid/

/ dus gsum dus med gzhi bral mnyam pa nyid/ /thams cad ye nas rdzogs pa'i ngang nyid do/ /snang srid 'khor 'das sems kyi gzugs brnyan te/ /sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /'gyur med rang bzhin gzod nas mya ngan 'das/ /gzhi nas byang chub kun tu bzang po yin/ /snang dang stong pa dbyer med gdod ma'i ngang*/ / gcig dang du mar mi dmigs spros dang bral/ /phyogs dang ris med thams cad mnyam pa nyid/ /snang mnyam bden mnyam brdzun par mnyam/ /yod mnyam med mnyam mtha' las 'das par mnyam/ /dbyings gcig gdod nas dag pa'i ngang nyid do/ /blo yis brtags pa thams cad ngo bos stong*/ / ming rnams glo bur rang mtshan sgro btags nyid/ /bden brdzun gnyis med yul sems 'brel pa med/ /gcig gis gcig la ma gos gzung 'dzin med/ /ji ltar me long gzugs bzhin snang ba ni/ /yul gyi rnam pa dbang po'i shes la shar/ /de nyid bzung bas chags sdang srid par 'khrul/ /nan tar gtugs ni sems ni ma 'phos shing*/ /yul gyi rnam pa'ang sems la shar ba med/ /ngo bo med phyir gnyis su ma grub bo/ /yul rnams thams cad rang bzhin med par gcig /blo rnams thams cad ngos gzung med par gcig /snang sems gnyis med gdod nas dag par gcig /brtag dpyad mi dgos gzhi nas grol bar gcig / 'khor 'das gnyis med sems kyi ngang du gcig /chu bo sna tshogs rgya mtsho'i ngang du gcig /thams cad ro mnyam lhan cig skyes par gcig /'byung bzhi'i 'pho 'gyur nam mkha'i ngang du gcig /sems kyi dgag sgrub stong pa'i ngang du gcig /gang shar rang grol gnyis med dag par gcig /dba' rlabs rol pa chu bo'i ngang du gcug /de ltar rtogs na skyes bu mkhas pa yin/ /sna tshogs ngos gzung med pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i gzugs brnyan te/ /bzang ngan blang dor med pa'i rol pa la/

/blo yis gnyis su ma 'dzin gang bder zhog /gtad med yul la nges med snang ba shar/ /'dzin med rig pa rnam yin chen po ni/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs yin/ /de ltar chos kun mnyam pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /blo bral ngang du 'dzin med la bzlas nas/ /phyogs bral rig pa khol bur bcings pa yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos sh-ig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las*/ /gzhi rtog pa'i shes rab mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// // de ltar chos kun mnyam pa'i don mthong nas/ /gnas lugs ngang la ji bzhin gzhag pa gces/ /de yang dbang po'i rim pas bstan pa ste/ /dbang po yang rab gnas lugs rtogs pas grol/ /sgom dang bsgom bya gnyis med don mthong nas/ /snang srid gzhi grol sems nyid bya btsal med/ /phyogs bral rig pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'char/ /thun mtshams ris med 'di yin nges gzung med/ /thams cad rang grol kun tu bzang po'i zhing*/ /rtags dang tshad med rang byung gzhi klong yangs/ /ji bzhin ngang la ye bzhin gnas pas na/ /gol dang gol sa rtsal sbyo?ng bogs 'byin med/ /thob dang ma thob med par thag chod pas/ /'bras bur smon med da lta rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de 'dra'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' rab 'byams yin/ /'bring dang tha mas goms la brtson dgos te/ /ji srid bdag 'dzin dbyings su ma nub par/ /de srid sna tshogs thabs kyis bsgom par bya/ khyad par rnam rtog ngan pas srid par 'khrid/ /de nyid grol phyir bsam gtan thabs la brten/ /phyi nas shes rab mtha' grol klong yangs 'char/ /zhi gnas kyis ni nyon mongs mgo gnon la/ /lhag mthong gis ni nyon mongs rtsa ba 'byin/ /des na rab kyis ngan rtog chos skur lhongs/ / bzang ngan med na gnyen po bsgom mi dgos/ /'bring gis ngang dngas zung 'brel bsgoms pa yis/ /bzang ngan rtog pa dbyings su nub gyur nas/

/zung 'brel rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu 'char/ / tha mas thog mar zhi gnas btsal ba yis/ /gang dmigs de la brtan pa thob par sla/ /de nas lhag mthong so sor rtog bsgoms pas/ /phy-i nang snang sems gzhi grol chen por 'char/ /des na dbang po'i rim pa shes pa gces/ /da ni dbang po 'bring gi sgom pa bltan/ / ji ltar chu ni dba' rlabs rnyog pa na/ /dngas pa'i gzugs brnyan mi gsal g.yo ba ltar/ /yid ni mi bsrun kun rtog 'phyar zhing g.yo/ /sna tshogs spros la kun tu 'chel ba na/ /sems nyid 'od gsal dngas pa'i ye shes dang*/ /spyan dang mngon shes gza' skar mi 'char bas/ /gcig tu mi g.yo mnyam par gzhag pa gces/ / lus ni chos bdun ri rgyal lta bu la/ /dbang po mtha' bral rdzing bu'i gza' skar 'dra/ /sems nyid stong gsal dngas pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /bying rgod gnyis med spros dang bral bar gzhag /de tshe rang bzhin gcig ste gdod ma'i ngang*/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa mi dmigs chos kyi sku/ /dri med 'od gsal nyi ma'i snying po ni/ /bde gsal mi rtog mtha' dbus med pa 'char/ /snang dang stong pa thams cad phyam gcig la/ /yod dang med pa kun gyi mtha' las 'das/ /srid dang zhi ba gnyis su mi rtog ba/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam med pa'i chos nyid mthong*/ /'di ni 'phags pa'i bden mthong ye shes rgyu/ /phyi nas de bzhin nyid mthong blo mig gis/ /rgyal ba'i chos sku phun tshogs bsgrub pas na/ /skal bzang rnams kyis rtag tu mnyam par zhog /sems nyid ma skyes mkha' ltar dag pa'i ngang/ / sems byung mi dmigs sprin tshogs dengs pa bzhin/ /yeng med sprod dang bral ba'i shes pa yis/ /ji bzhin ngang la ye bzhin mnyam par shog / dngas shing stongs pa rgya mtsho lta bu la/ /gzung 'dzin rnyog bral dba' rlabs med par zhog /stong zhing gsal ba nam mkha' lta bu la/ /kun rtog sprin med phyogs lhung bral bar zhog

/brtan zhing mi g.yo ri rgyal lta bu la/ /dgag sgrub gnyis med re dogs bral bar zhog /dag cing gsal ba me long lta bu la/ /snang yul ma 'gags gzugs brnyan lta bur zhog /ye grol sor gzhag 'ja' tshon lta bu la/ /bying rgod gnyis med dag cing gsal bar zhog /gzhan du ma yengs mda' mkhan lta bu la/ /gnyug ma'i ye shes spro bsdu bral bar zhog /thag chod shes pa las zin lta bu la/ /re dogs gnyis med lhun gyis grub par shog / 'di ni rang bzhin dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel pa yin/ /skye med ngang der gnas pas zhi gnas la/ /gsal stong spros dang bral bas lhag mthong nyid/ /dbyer med ngo bo gcig pas zung du 'brel/ /de tshe zab zhi spros dang bral ba'i sems/ /smra bsam brjod du med pa'i don mthong bas/ /snang ba'i ye shes shin tu mi rtog pa/ /'od gsal shes rab pha rol phyin zhes bya/ /de nyid mthong bas sems ni rab zhi zhing*/ /phyi nang chos la dgag sgrub zhen pa chung*/ /stong pa'i ngang nas snying rje phyogs med 'char/ /rang gzhan don du dge la spyod cing bskul/ /dben par dga' zhing rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi nyung*/ /rmi lam na yang dge ba'i chos la spyod/ /des ni thar pa'i lam sna zin pa yin/ /de nas ches cher gong du goms pa yis/ /sems gsal ye shes sngon bas rgya che zhing*/ / snang ba rmi lam sgyu mar rab tu rtogs/ /chos rnams gnyis med ngang du ro gcig pas/ /skyes dang ma skyes med par mthong ba'i tshe/ /mched pa'i ye shes shin tu mi rtog pa/ /bsam gtan dga' bas brgyan pa thob pa yin/ / de tshe lus sems sngon bas rab dag cing*/ /thabs dang shes rab dri med rtogs pa 'char/ /mngon shes ldan zhing snying rjes phan pa 'grub/ /srid la skyo bas sems ni nges par 'byung*/ /rmi lam na yang chos kun de 'drar rtogs/ / lus kyi phyi nang shig sro 'bu srin med/ /bying rgod bral zhing nyin mtshan ting 'dzin 'grub/

/skye bo des ni 'phags lam myur du mthong*/ /de nas ches cher goms pas sngon bas lhang*/ /ting 'dzin rtogs pa'i nyi ma sngon med 'char/ / chos kun tshul gcig mnyam pa'i don mthong nas/ /spyan dang mngon shes sgrib pa med mnga' bas/ /zhing khams brgya stong bye ba dpag med mthong*/ /de tshe zag med 'phags pa'i ye shes te/ /thob pa zhes bya mngon du gyur pa yin/ /de las ches cher gong du 'phel ba yis/ /rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin yon tan grangs med cing*/ /rtog dang mi rtog mnyam pa'i chos nyid las/ / gzungs sprin ye shes dri med rgya che zhing*/ /mnyam par gzhag dang ma bzhag gnyis med par/ /rtag tu mnyam gzhag sprul pa bsam yas ston/ /tshad med zhing dang ye shes gzigs pa 'jug /rtsa khams dag cing rlung sems yon tan mchog /shin tu rgya che dri ma med pa na/ /nye bar thob pa zhes bya'i ye shes te/ /'phags lam rdzogs nas myur du byang chub 'thob/ /'di ni 'od gsal snying po'i theg pa ste/ /skal bzang 'bras bu tshe 'dir grol pa yin/ /dbang po tha mas bsgoms pa'i rim pa yang*/ /dang por zhi lhag so sor rtsal sbyang ste/ /brtan par gyur nas zung 'jug dbyer med bsgom/ /de yang thabs tshul dpag med tshul la bslab/ /thog mar zhi gnas btsal ba'i rim pa ni/ /dben pa'i phyogs su stan la rab 'dug

nas/ /dbugs dbyungs 'jug pa'i kha dog grangs rnams kyis/ /nyin 'gar rnam rtog 'dul zhing gnas par bya/ /de nas byams sogs bzhi dang sems gnyis dang*/ /bskyed rim dang ni bris sku glegs bam sogs/ /dge ba'i yul nas gang yang rung zhig la/ /dmigs pa rtse gcig ma yengs mnyam par gzhag /de ltar bzhag pas sems ni las rung zhing*/ /gzhan du mi 'phro gar gtad yul la zin/ /ji tsam bzhag pa de tsam mnyam par gnas/ /lus ngag sems ni dga' bdes khyab pa na/ /rtse gcig mi g.yo'i zhi gnas grub pa yin/ /de nas lhag mthong don la bslab pa ni/ /phyi rol snang srid 'khor 'das chos 'di rnams/ /sna tshogs snang bas rmi lam sgyu 'dra zhing*/ /gzugs brnyan sprul pa sgra brnyan dri za'i grong*/ /mig yor smig rgyu 'dra zhing snying po med/ /snang bas stong ste rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang*/ /thams cad nam mkha' 'dra zhing bdag med pas/ /skye med spros dang bral par mnyam pa bzhag /de yis phyi rol chos la bdag med cing*/ /gzung dang gzung yul rang bzhin med par rtogs/ /de nas nang gi sems la 'di ltar brtag /sna tshogs rtog la ngo bo med pa'i sems/ /dgag sgrub bden brdzun bde sdug btang snyoms sogs/ /yul la 'phro zhing ngos gzung med pa khyod/ /dang po gang 'ongs da lta gang na gnas/ /tha ma gar 'gro dbyibs dang kha dog ci/ /snyam du brtags tshe 'di ltar mthong par 'gyur/ /sems ni dang por skye ba'i rgyus stong zhing*/ / bar du gnas dang tha ma 'gag pas stong*/ kha dog dbyibs med ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /'das pa 'gags shing ma 'ong ma skyes la/ /da lta mi gnas phyi nang gang na'ang med/ /nam mkha' 'dra zhing spros dang bral bar shes/ /de tshe sems la gang yang mi bsam par/ /chad pa ngal gso bzhin du lhod kyis glod/ /ci yang mi bsam yid la byed pa por/ /thams cad gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang la gzhag /de yis ngar 'dzin gang zag bdag med cing*/

/'dzin pa'i sems la rang bzhin med pa rtogs/ /de nas zung 'jug gnyug ma'i ye shes ni/ /snang sems gnyis med chu dang chu zla bzhin/ /gnyis su gzung bas srid par 'khrul na yang*/ /gnyis med shes pas mya ngan 'das zhir 'gro/ /de bas gnyis med don la 'di ltar bslab/ /chos rnams ma skyes sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /dri med stong gsal spros dang bral bar gzhag /de yis nyon mongs rnyog pa rab zhi zhing*/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes chen por gnas/ /rig dang mngon shes ting 'dzin 'grub 'gyur zhing*/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis med mtha' bral dbu ma rtogs/ /de tshe sems ni nam mkha' lta bu la/ /yul ni mi dmigs rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /sgom dang bsgom bya med pa'i chos nyid la/ /bya rgyu byed mkhan med pas gdod ma'i ngang/ /dri med rang bzhin dag pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ /gzung yul mi dmigs chu zla mig yor la/ /'dzin mkhan ma dmigs g.yo med phyogs lhung bral/ /snang sems gnyis med pha rol phyin pa'i ngang*/ / zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos nyid khong du chud/ /'dzin med yangs pa'i ting 'dzin gru chen gyis/ / srid gsum rgya mtsho'i pha rol brgal bas na/ /gzhi bde'i steng du blo bde rgyun mi 'chad/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du phyin/ /gnas pas zhi gnas chos sku stong pa la/ / gsal bar lhag mthong gzugs sku snang ba nyid/ /thabs dang shes rab tshogs gnyis bskyed rdzogs grub/ /lhag mthong rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyed byas nas/ /zhi gnas kyis ni de yi ngang la gnas/ /gang tshe gzung 'dzin dngos dang dngos med du/ /blo yi rnam pa rab tu mi gnas pa/ /de tshe dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med par/ /sems dang sems byung dmig pa med par zhi/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i sems nyid la/ /gnas skabs glo bur kun rtog dag pa

na/ /snyoms 'jug dgu dang rdzu 'phrul mngon shes 'grub/ /ting 'dzin grangs med gzugs sprin lhun gyis grub/ /rang sa 'dod pa'i sems gang rtse gcig pa/ /de las rtog dang dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /dga' bde'i yan lag bsam gtan dang po skye/ /de las rtog med dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /sems gsal dga' bde'i rang bzhin gnyis pa skye/ /de las rtog dpyod gnyis med ting nge 'dzin/ /dga' bdes brlan pa'i yan lag gsum pa skye/ /de las dga' ba sdud pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bzhi pa phan yon yan lag bcas pa skye/ /de las mkha' ltar dag cing dngas pa'i sems/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched thob par 'gyur/ /de las chos kun sems nyid spros pa med/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched thob par 'gyur/ /de las snang sems mi dmigs spros dang bral/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched 'grub par 'gyur/ /de las yod med spros kun bral ba'i sems/ /yod min med min skye mched 'grub par 'gyur/ /de las sna tshogs nyon mongs spros pa'i sems/ /rang bzhin 'gog pa zhi ba thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar mthar gyis snyoms 'jug dgu po yang*/ / rim dang rim min thod rgal rtsal sbyangs pas/ /rang bzhan snga phyi'i tshe rabs las rnams dang*/ / sems kyi spyod yul gang yin shes pa dang*/ /'chi 'pho skye dang sgrib pas chod kyang mthong*/ gcig dang du mar rdzu zhing rnam par 'phrul/ /nyon mongs med cing ji snyid ji bzhin shes/ /zhing rnams bde gshegs sras kyis gang ba mthong*/ /de tshe snang ba sgyu mar rab rtogs pas/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin nyid dang ni/ /sems kyi gdung bral rnyog par rab zhi'i phyir/ /zla ba dri ma med pa'i ting 'dzin dang*/ / chos kun mi dmigs mnyam pa'i ngang gcig pas/ /mkha' ltar gos pa med pa'i ting 'dzin sogs/ /brgya stong grangs med rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /lhag mthong gis ni rab tu rtogs pa'i don/

/zhi gnas dam pas rtse gcig gzung ba'i phyir/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzim zung 'brel lhun gyis grub/ /lam lnga'i rim pa bgrod las grol ba ste/ /tshogs lam chung ngur lus tshor sems dang chos/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi bsgom zhing*/ /'bring du 'dun dang 'bad rtsol brtson 'grus bzhis/ /dge dang mi dge'i zhen bzhi yang dag spong*/ /chen por 'dun sems dpyod dang dran pa bzhis/ /rdzu 'phrul rten 'grub rkang pa bzhi po bsgom/ /sbyor lam bzhi ste drod dang rtse mo ru/ /dad brtson dran dang ting 'dzin shes rab kyi/ /dbang po lnga dang bzod pa chos mchog tu/ /dad sogs stobs lnga rab tu sgom par byed/ /mthong ba'i lam ste rab tu dga' ba'i sar/ /dad brtson dran pa ting 'dzin shes rab dga'/ / shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi/ /yan lag bdun po dag ni legs bsgom zhing*/ /sgom lam chung 'bring chen po re re zhing*/ /chung ngu'i chung ngu chung ngu'i 'bring dang ni/ /chung ngu'i che sogs sa dgu rim pa bzhin/ /dri ma med dang 'od byed 'od 'phro can/ / sbyang dka' mngon gyur ring song mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin rnams su/ /yang dag lta dang rtog pa dag dang las/ /'tsho rtsol dran pa ting 'dzin 'phags lam brgyad/ /de ltar byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ / slob pa'i lam bzhir bsgoms pa'i mjug thogs su/ /mi slob sa la mi gnas mya ngan 'da'/ /de ltar sa dang lam rnams ma bgrod pa'i/ /sangs rgyas de 'dra nam yang 'byung ba med/ /bskal mang tshe rabs du ma tshe gang grol/ /de dag kun kyang lam 'dir brten pas na/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa gang la zhugs rnams kyis/ / sa dang lam rnams mkhyen nas bgrod par mdzod/ /de ltar zab zhi 'od gsal snying po yis/ /'gro kun sems kyi rnyog pa rab zhi nas/ /srid 'dir yun ring spros la 'chi ba yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos shig

/rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /lam bsam gtan dri ma med pa zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// // de ltar zung 'jug bsam gtan 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /ting 'dzin mi g.yo yan lag gsum la bslab/ /gang gis bsgrub pa cho ga'i yan lag dang*/ /ji ltar bsgrub pa thabs kyi yan lag dang*/ /gnyis med bsgrub pa ngo bo'i yan lag go /gang gis bsgrub pa'i skye bo nges 'byung can/ /lus ni 'du 'dzi'i grong las rgyang bsrings shing*/ /sems ni spros pa'i tshogs las ring du bsrings/ /de yis ting 'dzin 'di ni myur du 'grub/ /dad ldan ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod la/ /bag yod tshul khrims dag cing dge la spro/ /mang thos 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes ldan/ /de yis ting 'dzin 'di ni myur du 'grub/ /lus sems bsdams shing dben par gnas la dga'/ /gnyid dang snyom las smra la dga' ba spongs/ / rgod 'gyod med cing gzhan dang 'dris pa nyung*/ /de yis ting 'dzin 'di ni myur du 'grub/ /grong dang grong 'dab skye bo'i 'du 'dzi med/ /gnas dang dgon par mang po'i rten 'dris med/ /don dang bya ba sna tshogs brel ba med/ /de yis ting 'dzin 'di ni myur du 'grub/ /tshe 'di'i bde dang phyi ma'i bde 'bras dang*/ /rang don zhi ba gnyer min 'gro ba'i phyir/ /srid las thar 'dod nges 'byung skyo shas can/ / de yis ting 'dzin mchog 'di myur du 'grub/ /ji ltar bsgrub pa thabs kyi yan lag kyang*/ /gnyid rmugs rgod 'gyod the tshom sgrib pa lnga/ /spangs te zhi lhag gzung 'brel tshul gyis bsgrub/ /gnyid rmugs gnyis kyis zhi gnas rab tu sgrib/ /rgod 'gyos gnyis kyis lhag mthong rnam par g.yeng*/ /the tshom gnyis ka'i gnod byed mi mthun phyogs/ /de ltar lnga nyid bying rgod gnyis su 'du/ / bying na gseng zhing rgod na rtse gcig bsgom/ /zhi gnas med pa'i lhag mthong spros la rgod/

lhag mthong med pa'i zhi gnas lung ma bstan/ /zung 'brel sgrib pa'i gnyen po mchog gi lam/ /zhi gnas lus ngag yid sems dal bas 'grub/ /de yang chos kun rang bzhin mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /dmigs pa rab zhi gtso bo'i yan lag yin/ /dmigs pa gcig las sems 'dzin 'khor gyi tshul/ /de yang snang bcas snang med rnam pa gnyis/ /phyi nang gnyis te bzhi yis zin par 'gyur/ /snang bcas gzugs sogs sgo lnga'i yul rnams la/ /snang med mi rtog rtse gcig ngang la 'jog /phy-i rol rdo shing sku gzugs la sogs dang*/ /nang nyid snying gar padma 'thur 'phyang sogs/ /dmigs yul gcig la rtse gcig sems 'jog pa/ /zhi gnas bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi yan lag yin/ / de yis rtse gcig zhi gnas skyes pa'i tshe/ /spel zhing brtan phyir lhag mthong ye shes spro/ /bogs 'byin spyod lam kun dang bsre ba gces/ /ltengs na lus sems gsengs la sngar bzhin bsgom/ /'dis ni myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /lhag mthong 'dod pas sems gsal dngas pa'i ngang*/ /so sor rtog pa gtso bo'i yan lag la/ /mi rtog mnyam par 'jog pa 'khor gyi tshul/ /de yang chos can chos nyid rnam pa gnyis/ /chos can sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad blta bya zhing*/ / chos nyid mkha' ltar stong pa'i rtsal sbyang bya/ /ji bzhin ngang la bzhag pas ye shes 'char/ /ltengs na sna tshogs chos la rtsal sbyang ste/ /sgyu ma stong pa gnyis med dag par blta/ /'phro na zhi gnas ngang la mnyam par gzhag /de tshe nam mkha' lta bu'i 'od gsal ni/ /stong gsal spros dang bral ba'i ngo bo mthong*/ / de yus sgrib gnyis sprin las grol ba 'grub/ /res 'ga' rgya mtsho lta bu'i 'od gsal 'char/ /shar grol ngang dngas rtog med lhun gyis grub/ /bogs 'byin spyos lam kun dang de nyid bsre/ /'dis ni lhag mthong myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zung 'jug shes pa 'phro gnas mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /gnyis kar mi rtog ye shes gtso bo la/

/yeng med spros dang bral ba 'khor gyi tshul/ /ji ltar shar gnas de yi ngang bzhag pas/ /shar bas grol la gnas pas mnyam pa nyid/ /zhi lhag zung 'brel bde gsal mi rtog 'char/ /snang stong thabs shes bskyed rdzogs lhun gyis grub/ /ltengs na zhi lhag so sor rtsal sbyang zhing*/ /bying rgod tshe na ldog la bsgoms par bya/ / bogs 'byin nam mkha' dngas shing sprin med tshe/ /nyi mar rgyab phyogs mkha' la rab bltas pas/ /stong gsal shes pa spros dang bral ba 'char/ / phyi rol dpe yi nam mkha' dag pa las/ /nang gi chos nyid don gyis nam mkha' che/ /gsang ba 'od gsal snying po'i nam mkha' ste/ /nam mkha' sum sprugs dgongs pa shes par bya/ /gnyis med bsgrub pa ngo bo'i yan lag ni/ /thams cad ro mnyam rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ /spang blang mi bya dmigs gtad zhen pa dor/ /'dzin zhen thams cad srid pa'i 'du byed la/ /dmigs gtad med na mkha' bzhin bcings grol med/ /ji ltar gzugs brnyan sna tshogs me long ngang*/ /de ltar chos rnams sna tshogs stong pa'i ngang*/ /ji ltar sprin rnams sna tshogs nam mkha'i ngang*/ /de bzhin dgag sgrub sna tshogs sems nyid ngang*/ /ji ltar chu bo sna tshogs rgya mtsho'i ngang*/ /de bzhin nyams rtogs sna tshogs bsgom pa'i ngang*/ /ji ltar sgyu ma sna tshogs sprul pa'i ngang*/ /de bzhin 'khor 'das sna tshogs chos nyid ngang*/ /ji ltar phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' gzhi bral ngang*/ /de bzhin ye grol chos rnams lta ba'i ngang*/ /ji ltar chu la chu bzhag gnyis med ngang*/ /de bzhin sems dang sems nyid dbyer med ngang*/ /ji ltar sna tshogs rmi lam gnyid kyi ngang*/ /de bzhin blang dor gnyis med spyod pa'i ngang*/ /ji ltar mtsho dang dba' rlabs chu bo'i ngang*/ /de bzhin rtog dang mi rtog mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /ji ltar tshong pa don grub bde ba'i ngang*/ /de bzhin re dogs gnyis med 'bras bu'i ngang*/ thams cad phyam gcig rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/

khyab gdal dbyings kyi chos nyid shes par bya/ /de ltar sna tshogs gnyis med ro gcig gis/ /'gro kun bdag gzhan gzung 'dzin las grol te/ /'di zhes dmigs pas 'khrul pa'i srid pa 'dir/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gsol las/ / ting nge 'dzin bsgrub pa'i yan lag thabs la mkhas pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// // de ltar thabs dang shes rab mthar phyin nas/ /sku dang ye shes phrin las lhun gyis grub/ /sems dang sems byung kun gzhir bcas pa kun/ / chos kyi dbyings su 'jug pa rab zhi'i tshe/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med ro gcig gyur/ /de tshe dag pa gnyis ldan spros kun zhi/ /shin tu skye med 'od gsal snying po'i ngang*/ /gnam gang zla ba dbyings su nub pa ltar/ /phra ba'i ye shes mkha' dbyings padmor 'khyil/ /gang du'ang mi rtog zhi ba brnyes pa'i tshe/ /chos nyid mi dmigs dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i cha de la/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku zhes brjod pa ste/ /gzhi dbyings zad pa'i chos nyid mthar thug pa'o/ /rang bzhin glo bur sgrib gnyis rnam dag cing*/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho brnyes/ spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyir pas/ /stobs sogs pha rol phyin pa'i chas gzhal na/ /mngon par byang chub sku zhes btags pa ste/ /ma 'dres yon tan 'char gzhi mthar thug

pa'o/ /shes bya'i yul la de blo mi 'jug cing*/ /shes byed blo la 'dzin pa mi dmigs kyang*/ /nang gsal mkha' dbyings nub pa'i zla ba ltar/ /thim la ma rmugs phra ba'i ye shes mchog /thams cad mkhyen chas 'char gzhi ngo bo'i tshul/ /de las gzugs sku rnam mkhyen mched 'gyur zhing*/ /gzhan la snang mdzad yon tan gter yin phyir/ /shin tu ches phra'i ye shes rab zhi'i chas/ /zhi ba chos kyi sku zhes rab tu brjod/ /'di dag phyi rol yul la mi 'jug cing*/ / chad pa ma yin shin tu phra ba'i phyir/ /rtag dang chad sogs mu bzhi'i mtha' las 'das/ /smra bsam brjod med pha rol phyin pa'i ngang*/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin dmigs pa rab zhi bas/ /rgyal ba rnams las gzhan gyi spyod yul min/ /chos dbyings pho brang shin tu skye med na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad rtag bzhugs kyang*/ /gcig gis gcig mi gzigs te chos nyid phyir/ /rang bzhin zab zhir bzhugs zhes gsungs pa yin/ /de nyid ngang du rgyal rnams dgongs klong gcig /bum mkha' snga phyi'i nam mkha' gcig pa bzhin/ /'di ni chos nyid stong pa shes rab dang*/ /ye shes tshogs dang rdzogs rim mthar thug pa'o/ / de nyid ngang las rang snang longs spyod rdzogs/ /gnas dus ston pa chos 'khor phun tshogs las/ /gnas ni 'od gsal stug po bkod pa'i zhing*/ /lnga ldan 'od kyi lhun stug gsal zhing 'tsher/ /'ja' tshon gdangs gsal nam mkha' gang ba bzhin/ / steng 'og phyogs mtshams nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/ /gzhal med khang mdzes sgo bzhi rta babs ldan/ /rtsig pa lnga dang pha gu dra phyed dang*/ / mda' yab pu shu gtsang khang phyur bus mdzes/ 'phan gdugs rnga yab dril bu'i phreng ba dang*/ /bla re rgyal mtshan la sogs nam mkha' gang*/ 'dod yon lha mo mchod pa'i sprin 'phro zhing*/ /'od zer 'khyil bas phyi nang kun tukhyab/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi so so'i kha dog la/ mthun pa'i rgyan dang kha dog rnam par

bkra/ /che chung ma nges gang bltas de ltar snang*/ /grangs ni tshad med nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab/ /ji ltar til gyi gang bu phye ba bzhin/ /kun gyi nang na se ge glang chen rta/ /rma bya shang shang nyi zla padmas spras/ /dus ni ma nges gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med/ /dus gsun dus med kun tu bzang po'i dus/ /thams cad mnyam rdzogs chos nyid gdal ba che/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i ngang nyid do/ /ston pa mtshan rdzogs dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin 'byung 'od dpag med/ /don grub lnga po lnga lngas bskor ba la/ /nam mkha' dbyings phyug rdo rje ma mā kī/ /sangs rgyas spyan dang gos dkar dam tshig sgrol/ / yab yub mnyam sbyor so so'i rgyan rnams rdzogs/ /mthing ga dkar ser dmar ljang 'od zer 'phro/ /'og gzhi zhi ba steng gzhi khro bo'i tshul/ /buddha badzra ratna padma kar/ /he ru ka dpal lnga lngas bskor ba yang*/ /kro dhī shwa rī lnga dang mnyam par sbyor*/ /de sogs rnam par brjod kyis mi lang ngo*/ /chos ni rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ /smra bsam brjod du med pa'i klong nyid do/ /'khor ni nyid las mi zhan rang snang 'khor/ /sems dpa' brgyad dang de bzhin sems ma brgyad/ /sgo ba bzhi dang sgo ma rnam pa bzhi/ /zhi ba rang bzhin bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis las/ /drug ni gzhan la snang phyir sprul pa ste/ /gnyis ni dbyings na gnas phyir chos kyi sku/ /rang snang zhi ba longs sku sum cu bzhi/ /khyad par 'khor ni nyi shu bzhir gnas so/ khro bo'i 'khor ni kau sing phra men brgyad/ /sgo skyong bzhi dang dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ khro bo rang bzhin lnga bcu rtsa brgyad las/ khyad par 'khor ni bzhi bcu brgyad dang bcas/ /'bar ba'i cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /shin tu mi bzad gar dgus rol pa 'o/ /gzhan yang lus grub dkyil 'khor ji snyed pa/ /de snyed rang snang longs sku'i zhing khams yin/

/ gzhan snang gdul bya'i zhi khro ji snyed pa/ /sprul skus bsdus phyir rang snang longs sku min/ de ltar phun sum tshogs pa rnam lnga'i zhing*/ /thams cad rang snang yin phyir bzang ngan med/ /kun kyang gsal 'tsher lhun stug 'od zer 'phro/ /lham me lhan ne lhang nge'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ /'di ni 'dren pa rnams kyi spyod yul te/ /gcig gis gcig gzigs de yi bsngags pa brjod/ /de ltar yid 'ong kun nas bkod pa'i zhing*/ /dag pa'i gdul bya yis kyang mthong mi nus/ /rang snang stong gzugs bzhin du bsam mi khyab/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi rang snang ngo*/ /de nyid ngang las gdul bya'i 'jig rten du/ /'dul byed ston pa rim gyis snang ba ni/ /rang bzhin 'gro 'dul sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /rnam pa gsum gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /de yang rang bzhin sprul sku'i ston pa ni/ / 'og min mngon dga' dpal ldan padma brtsegs/ /las rab grub pa'i 'jig rten rnam pa lngar/ /rnam snang mi bskyod la sogs rigs lnga'i sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad 'od zer 'bar ba la/ /zhi dang khro tshul dpag med tshul 'chang bas/ / 'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzad/ /de yang ye shes lnga lnga'i rang bzhin te/ /chos dbyings me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya grub ye shes rnam pa lnga po yang*/ /re re'i 'khor du bzhi bzhi ldan pa ste/ /thams cad ro mnyam gcig gi ngang nyid do/ / chos dbyings ye shes shin tu mi g.yo ba/ /gzung 'dzin spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa yin/ /me long ye shes gsal stong 'char gzhi'i tshul/ /ye shes kun gyi 'byung gnas chen po yin/ /mnyam nyid ye shes chos kun mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /'khor 'das gnyis med mnyam rdzogs chen po yin/ /kun rtog ye shes shes bya ma 'dres mkhyen/ /ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa rnam dag yin/ /bya grub ye shes phrin las phun sum tshogs/ /shes bya kun la rtag thogs med pa yin/

/gdul bya'i 'khor ni sa bcu'i sems dpa' la/ / chos ni ting 'dzin 'od zer rab bkye bas/ /sa de'i sgrib pa sbyong ba'i blo skyes nas/ /ser sna la sogs spangs te rgyal la blta/ /da dung de 'dra'i ston pa rnam dag dang*/ /bdag nyid khyad par mthong nas sgrib pa sbyong*/ /kun du 'od kyi bar du 'god pa ste/ /gzugs bzang me long bstan pas don mdzad do/ /dus ni 'gro grol bar du rgyun mi 'chad/ /longs sku'i zhing na khor mor snang ba yin/ /de ltar rigs lngar nges pa'i rang bzhin yang*/ /gdul bya gti mug shas cher sbyong ba'i tshe/ /zhing ni 'og min ston pa rnam snang la/ /chos ni chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /de bzhin zhe sdang sbyang phyir mi bskyod zhing*/ /nga rgyal rin 'byung 'dod chags 'od dpag med/ /phrag dog sbyang phyir don grub snang ba yin/ /de ltar ston pa longs spyod rdzogs na yang*/ /'khor sogs ston pa nyid las gzhan yin pas/ thams cad longs spyod rdzogs min de yi phyir/ /phyed sprul nyid de rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku/ /dag pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snang ba yin/ /sar gnas rnams las gdul bya gzhan la min/ /de phyir phyed snang sprul pa'i sku zhes bya/ / zhing de khod mnyam yid 'ong gzhal med khang*/ /rin chen bdun ldan 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro/ / padma las skyes rgyal sras dpag tu med/ /longs spyod sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i char pa 'bab/ /dus bzhir chos gsung dri med g.yer kha'i sgra/ /dpag bsam rin chen chu mtshos rab tu mdzes/ /'di ni zhi ba rang bzhin sprul pa yin/ /de bzhin khro tshul dkyil 'khor dpag tu med/ /mkha' 'gro sprin phung 'phro ba'i mkha' spyod gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rigs lnga'i zhing khams nyid/ / gsang sngags grub la rab tu snang ba yin/ /'di ni deng sang bde chen mkha' spyod ces/ /mkhas grub rnams la rab tu grags pa yin/ /de nyid ngang las 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku/

/'gro drug gnas su rang rang ston par snang*/ / de yang brgya byin thags bzangs ris dang ni/ /shākya thub pa seng ge rab brtan dang*/ kha 'bar de ba a wa glang mgo ste/ /thub pa drug gis phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams su/ /'gro ba drug gi rgyud drug so sor sbyong*/ /de yang gtso bo'i grangs te sprul pa dang*/ /yang sprul rnams ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /lha yi gnas su'ang gnas ris so so ru/ /tshangs dang dbang phyug 'og min bar snyed du/ /rang rang 'dul byed ston pa'i tshul rnams snang*/ /mi la'ang gang 'dul de la der snang ste/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rgyal po la sogs sprul nas mi rnams 'dul/ /lha min gnas su'ang so so'i 'dul byed dang*/ /dud 'gro'i ris su'ang bya la byar snang zhing*/ /ri dgas rnams la seng ge mchog la sogs/ /so so'i 'dul byed ston pa bsam mi khyab/ /de bzhin yi dgas dmyal ba'i 'jig rten du/ /rang rang mthun pa'i gzugs kyis don mdzad do/ /de ltar 'gro 'dul rnams la ye shes gnyis/ /ji ltar ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rnam pa ste/ / chos nyid dang ni chos can ma 'dres par/ /so sor mkhyen nas gdul bya'i don gnyis mdzad/ /ji ltar ye shes stong pa'i dngos mkhyen nas/ /'gro la nye bar zhi ba'i chos ston zhing*/ /ji snyed ye shes sems dang dbang po sogs/ /ma 'dres mkhyen nas chos tshul bsam yas ston/ /'di ni ma dag 'gro la snang ba ste/ / zhing ni 'gro drug 'jig rten drug rnams su/ /ston pa 'gro 'dul rang snang mthun pa yis/ /chos ni ma nges theg pa sna tshogs nyid/ /dus ni gdul bya'i skal ba mtshungs par snang*/ /de ltar 'gro drug 'jig rten drug po yang*/ /las dang bag chags dge sdig rgyu 'bras kyis/ /bde sdug mtho dman rnam pa sna tshogs nyid/ / ston pa drug kyang 'gro sems rang snang ste/ /rmi lam nang gi sangs rgyas sems can bzhin/

/ngo bo dag kyang rnam pa ma dag pas/ /sna tshogs snang la thugs rje'i rol pa shar/ /'di ni tshad med thugs rje'i sprul pa yin/ /srid pa ji srid phrin las rgyun mi 'chad/ /de nyid ngang las sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /sems med bems po'i tshul gyis snang ba ste/ /ris su bris dang 'bur dang rang byon dang*/ / yi ge la sogs mchod pa'i rten dang ni/ / padma dpag bsam shing dang skyed mos tshal/ /khang bzangs mchog dang kun dga'i ra ba dang*/ /sprul pa'i grang dang gru gzings zam pa dang*/ /mar me nor bu zas gos bzhon pa sogs/ /'gro ba'i don mang byed pa'i bems por snang*/ /gnas skabs dga' skyid bde ba'i gnas mdzad nas/ /mthar thug zhi ba'i lam la 'god pas na/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro don lhun kyis grub/ /gdul bya med na 'dul byed dbyings su nub/ /rang snang longs sku chos sku'i ngang du thim/ /chu snod med na chu zla mkha' la thim/ / tshes kyi dbang gis zla ba dbyings su nub/ /gnam gang zla ba 'phel 'grib med pa bzhin/ /gdul bya yod na sngon bzhin rim gyis snang*/ /'di ni 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /de ltar zhi ba mchog gi rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro kun sems nyid 'od gsal dbyings gzhol te/ /srid zhi'i mthar 'dzin nyes cha'i dri ma yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos shig /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /'bras bu lhun grub chen po'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// // de ltar legs bshad bsod nams sprin chen las/ /zhi bde'i rang bzhin char gyi tshogs mang pos/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i dge legs rab rgyas te/ /rgyal ba'i 'byor tshogs lhun gyis grub par shog /deng sang phal gyi blo mig ma dag pas/ /sngags dang pha rol phyin gzhung so so'i lam/ /'gal bar 'dzin pas gcig tu sdud mi shes/ /de phyir de dag phyogs re'i mig can yin/ /'dir ni rgyu 'bras theg pa'i zab don mchog

/gcig tu bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i thabs/ /gangs ri thod dkar o rgyan rdzong gnas su/ / dri med 'od zer shar bas legs par bkod/ /dge ba de yis srid pa'i sems can rnams/ /ma lus nyer zhi'i go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yis/ / phyogs dus kun du bkra shis byed par shog /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso zhes bya ba/ /dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po blo ldan mchog sred kyis rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du legs par sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o dge'o/ dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (20)rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso/ - PAGE 2 -- PAGE 3 -- PAGE 1 -
